Pane tostato con crema di cannellini e c: Toast with cannellini cream and broccoli florets sautéed with garlic and chilli.
Pane tostato con cubetti di feta, pomodo: Toast with cubes of feta, cherry tomatoes and cucumber, oil, pepper and basil.
Pane tostato con mozzarella che si ammor: Toast with mozzarella softened by the heat, leeks stewed with sage and chilli and chopped pistachios.
Pane tostato con una crema di tofu frull: Toast with a cream of tofu blended with green apple and mint, radishes in rounds and pumpkin seeds.
Pane tostato spalmato con yogurt mescola: Toast spread with yogurt mixed with chopped walnuts, pomegranate seeds and honey.
Pane tostato spalmato di caprino, con fa: Toast spread with fresh goat's cheese, with raw fresh broad beans, lemon zest, thyme and pepper.
Pane tostato spalmato di ricotta al limo: Toast spread with lemon ricotta, with sautéed prawns and chives.
Panettone casalingo senza lievito di bir: A homemade panettone without yeast, with raisins and candied fruit, in a tall mould.
Panini di pasta lievitata una notte con: Rolls of dough risen overnight with water and butter, glazed with milk.
Panini dolci di farina gialla con uvetta: Sweet maize-flour buns with raisins, butter and lard, leavened and baked.
Panini dolci lievitati aperti e farciti: Sweet yeasted buns split open and filled with plenty of whipped cream. They are eaten fresh at breakfast, with the cream spilling out at the sides.
Panini svuotati, inzuppati nel latte e f: Hollowed rolls, soaked in milk and fried, filled with giblets and truffle.
Panino con milza e polmone di vitello co: A roll with veal spleen and lung cooked in strutto, schietto or maritato. Palermo street food: it is eaten hot, standing, freshly made.
Panino tondo di pasta di pane con olive,: A round roll of bread dough with olives, filled as you like. Soft inside and crisp outside, it is eaten hot, filled.
Panna cotta alleggerita con yogurt greco: A lighter panna cotta made with Greek yogurt and milk, in small glasses, under a crumble of almonds, wholemeal biscuits and honey.
Panna montata con zucchero e cannella ch: Whipped cream with sugar and cinnamon enclosed in a mould lined with ladyfingers.
Pannocchie di granturco dolce lessate e: Cobs of sweetcorn boiled and served with butter and salt.
Papero e vitello rosolati a lungo nel so: Gosling and veal browned for a long time in the soffritto and cooked for two hours in tomato.
Pappa di farina di mais e di grano con b: A batter of maize and wheat flour with butter, walnuts and raisins, baked for an hour.
Pappa di zucca, latte e farina di mais,: A porridge of pumpkin, milk and maize flour, halfway between soup and polenta. Soft and sweet with pumpkin: it is eaten hot, with a spoon.
Pappardelle all'uovo col sugo di conigli: Egg pappardelle with rabbit sauce; the rabbit is served as a main course.
Pappardelle all'uovo con ragù di cinghia: Egg pappardelle with a ragù of wild boar marinated in red wine. A dark, rich game ragù: it is served hot, in autumn and winter.
Pappardelle larghe con il sugo di lepre: Wide pappardelle with a sauce of hare cooked for a long time in red wine. A dark, rich game sauce: it is served hot, in autumn and winter.
Pappina di farina di granturco, uova e l: A soft batter of maize flour, eggs and milk, cooked over a fierce heat and rolled up.
Passare in forno a 200 °C con il grill p: Switch to the oven at 200 °C with the grill for 8 minutes until the surface is golden.
Passarli nel forno a 100 °C per 10 minut: Pass them in the oven at 100 °C for 10 minutes to dry the glaze.
Passatelli di filetto pestato, pangratta: Passatelli of pounded fillet, breadcrumbs, bone marrow and parmesan, cooked in broth.
Passatelli di semolino cotto nel latte,: Passatelli of semolina cooked in milk, with eggs and parmesan, cooked in broth.
Passatelli gialli e verdi di pasta al la: Yellow and green passatelli of a milk, egg and spinach dough, pushed into the broth.
Passato di zucca e patate lessate, servi: A purée of boiled pumpkin and potatoes, served with raw oil, parmesan and bread croûtons.
Pasta a barchetta condita con sugo di ma: Boat-shaped pasta dressed with a beef sauce with dried mushrooms and Parmigiano.
Pasta a forma di 8 fatta a mano, condita: Handmade figure-of-eight pasta, dressed in layers with beef sauce and Parmigiano.
Pasta a spirale con pesto crudo di pomod: Spiral pasta with a raw pesto of tomato, almonds, garlic and basil. Fresh and fragrant, it is eaten in summer, at room temperature.
Pasta al burro e limone coperta di mele: A butter and lemon pastry covered with chunks of apple, sugar and cinnamon.
Pasta al forno con melanzane fritte, rag: Baked pasta with fried aubergines, ragù, hard-boiled eggs, caciocavallo and salame. It is served hot or warm, in slices: a festive dish of eastern Sicily.
Pasta all'uovo rigata sul pettine da tel: Egg pasta ridged on the loom comb, with duck sauce. Rough and ridged, they catch the sauce: they are served hot, with parmesan.
Pasta all'uovo sottilissima tagliata a m: Very thin hand-cut egg pasta, dressed with ragù. Very thin, they cook in a moment: they are served at once, with hot ragù.
Pasta arrotolata al ferretto con sugo di: Pasta rolled on an iron rod with tomato sauce and spicy 'nduja. Spicy and red, rich in sauce: a typical dish of the Vibo Valentia area.
Pasta con guanciale croccante, pecorino: Pasta with crisp guanciale, pecorino romano and pepper: amatriciana without tomato. White and creamy, with crisp guanciale: serve it at once, hot.
Pasta con guanciale, pomodoro e pecorino: Pasta with guanciale, tomato and pecorino from Amatrice. A red, savoury sauce with the fat of the guanciale: serve it with grated pecorino.
Pasta con mollica tostata e alici, piatt: Pasta with toasted breadcrumbs and anchovies, a communal Calabrian dish. Crunchy and tasting of the sea: it is served at once, hot.
Pasta con mollica tostata, acciughe e uv: Pasta with toasted breadcrumbs, anchovies and raisins: the «poor man's cheese». Crunchy and savoury: it is served at once, with more breadcrumbs on top.
Pasta con pesto di pistacchio verde di B: Pasta with a pesto of green Bronte pistachio, oil and pecorino. Green and fragrant, it is served at once with chopped pistachios.
Pasta con pomodoro, melanzane fritte, ri: Pasta with tomato, fried aubergines, ricotta salata and basil. It is served hot, with plenty of grated ricotta salata on top.
Pasta con salsiccia di Norcia, panna o r: Pasta with Norcia sausage, cream or ricotta and black truffle. Creamy and full of sausage flavour: it is served at once, hot.
Pasta con un pesto di noci, aglio e noce: Pasta with a pesto of walnuts, garlic and nutmeg blended with soy drink, and courgettes, pepper and onion sautéed with chilli.
Pasta con un sugo di ceci stufati con po: Pasta with a sauce of chickpeas stewed with tomato, garlic and bay and broccoli florets.
Pasta con una crema di zucchine e fagiol: Pasta with a cream of courgettes and cannellini beans blended with herbs, plus whole beans and parmesan.
Pasta condita a crudo con una crema di a: Pasta dressed off the heat with a cream of avocado, baby spinach and lemon, garnished with sun-dried tomatoes.
Pasta condita con barbabietola cotta fru: Pasta dressed with blended cooked beetroot, which turns it pink, and diced mozzarella.
Pasta condita con carote stufate alla ma: Pasta dressed with carrots stewed with marjoram and ricotta loosened with milk, with parmesan and raw oil.
Pasta condita con semolino tostato nello: Pasta dressed with semolina toasted in lard, the German way of Trentino.
Pasta condita con un ragù di carota, por: Pasta dressed with a ragù of carrot, leek and courgette, stewed and cooked for a long time in tomato.
Pasta condita con un sugo leggero di pom: Pasta dressed with a light sauce of tomato and white fish in small pieces, with parsley.
Pasta condita con una crema di melanzane: Pasta dressed with a cream of aubergines and peppers stewed with onion and garlic and then blended, with parsley and parmesan.
Pasta condita con una salsa di fave e ci: Pasta dressed with a sauce of blanched broad beans and spring onions, blended with oil, garlic and parmesan.
Pasta condita con zucca e cipolla stufat: Pasta dressed with pumpkin and onion stewed in vegetable broth until they break down, with parmesan and raw oil.
Pasta corta con un pesto cremoso di zucc: Short pasta with a creamy pesto of blanched courgettes, ricotta, parmesan and basil.
Pasta corta con un sugo di pomodoro, ton: Short pasta with a sauce of tomato, tuna, button mushrooms and cannellini beans, finished with plenty of parsley.
Pasta corta con zucchine a rondelle roso: Short pasta with courgette rounds browned with garlic, coloured by saffron and finished with parsley.
Pasta corta condita con un pesto di broc: Short pasta dressed with a pesto of boiled broccoli blended with pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and oil, plus a few whole florets.
Pasta corta cotta insieme ai gambi di as: Short pasta cooked together with asparagus stalks and tossed with tips, red and yellow cherry tomatoes and cubes of fresh tuna.
Pasta corta cotta nella stessa acqua del: Short pasta cooked in the same water as the cauliflower, dressed with oil, garlic, anchovies and toasted breadcrumbs.
Pasta corta integrale con asparagi, fagi: Short wholemeal pasta with asparagus, green beans and onion stewed in a pan.
Pasta cotta in pentola e fritta a pallin: A dough cooked in the pan and fried in balls or star-shaped sticks, sugared.
Pasta cotta sul fuoco con burro, zuccher: A paste cooked on the heat with butter, sugar and citron zest, beaten with the eggs and scented with candied citron flowers and amaretti, baked in egg-shaped spoonfuls: little Neapolitan bignè.
Pasta d'uovo asciugata e tritata in bric: Egg pasta dried and chopped into tiny crumbs, cooked in meat broth.
Pasta di acqua e farina a sezione quadra: A pasta of water and flour with a square cross-section, with oil, garlic and Norcia black truffle. A rough, chewy pasta, barely dressed so that the truffle comes through: a dish of Umbria.
Pasta di acqua e farina arrotolata a man: A pasta of water and flour rolled by hand, dressed with Romagna ragù. Thick, rough pasta that holds the sauce well: it is served hot, with parmesan.
Pasta di grano saraceno con un pesto a c: Buckwheat pasta with a raw pesto of boiled asparagus, almonds, garlic and soy drink, scented with lemon thyme.
Pasta di magro con olive, capperi, uvett: Meatless pasta with olives, capers, raisins, pine nuts and anchovies, loved by Leopardi. Savoury and sweet-and-sour, it is served at once, hot.
Pasta di pane fritta in olio e passata n: Bread dough fried in oil and rolled in sugar or filled with cured meats. Puffed and golden, it is eaten hot, sweet or savoury.
Pasta di patate con burro, zucchero, tuo: A potato paste with butter, sugar, yolks, cinnamon and candied citron, baked in the mould.
Pasta dolce al marsala ripiena di frutta: A sweet Marsala pastry filled with seasonal fruit cooked in wine, prunes and citron.
Pasta dura di farina, uova e formaggio g: A stiff dough of flour, eggs and cheese grated into crumbs and cooked in broth.
Pasta fatta in casa a losanghe con ragù: Home-made pasta in diamonds with lamb ragù. Wide, substantial pasta and a savoury ragù: it is served hot with pecorino.
Pasta fresca al latte e basilico con fru: Fresh pasta made with milk and basil, with seafood and cherry tomatoes. Short, thick pasta scented with basil: it is served at once, a dish of the Amalfi Coast.
Pasta fresca arrotolata con sugo di pomo: Fresh rolled pasta with fresh tomato sauce, an old Calabrian recipe. Rustic pasta and a simple sauce: it is served at once, hot.
Pasta fresca con peperoni di Senise essi: Fresh pasta with dried Senise peppers fried crisp and breadcrumbs. The cruschi are sweet and crunchy like crisps: they are crumbled over the pasta.
Pasta fresca di farina e acqua tagliata: Fresh pasta of flour and water cut into diamonds, cooked with beans in a sauce of tomato, lard and chilli.
Pasta fresca in parte lessata e in parte: Fresh pasta partly boiled and partly fried, with stewed chickpeas. A little soft and a little crisp: it is eaten hot, a typical dish of the Salento.
Pasta integrale con finocchi appassiti i: Wholemeal pasta with fennel softened in a pan and fresh mackerel in pieces, finished with orange juice.
Pasta integrale con un pesto crudo di ra: Wholemeal pasta with a raw pesto of radicchio, almonds, garlic and oil, instead of basil.
Pasta integrale con un pesto di edamame,: Wholemeal pasta with a pesto of edamame, almonds and sun-dried tomatoes thinned with the cooking water.
Pasta integrale fredda con piselli, pomo: Cold wholemeal pasta with peas, sun-dried tomatoes in strips, celery, almonds and capers.
Pasta integrale fredda condita con una c: Cold wholemeal pasta dressed with a blended cream of peas, courgettes, Greek yogurt, lemon and mint.
Pasta lunga a sezione quadrata di Irpini: A long, square-section pasta of Irpinia, dressed with ragù. Thick, rough pasta with the Sunday ragù: it is served hot.
Pasta mantecata a crudo con una salsa di: Pasta tossed off the heat with a raw sauce of chopped pine nuts, marjoram, Parmigiano and milk.
Pasta mantecata come un risotto in un su: Pasta finished like a risotto in a sauce of asparagus, dried porcini and pancetta, with parsley and grana.
Pasta mantecata con crema di pecorino ro: Pasta tossed with a cream of pecorino romano and toasted pepper. Few ingredients, a smooth cream sharp with pepper: serve it at once, before it sets.
Pasta mista cotta nelle patate con crost: Mixed pasta cooked with potatoes, cheese rinds and stringy provola. Thick and creamy, with the provola stretching into strings: it is eaten hot.
Pasta ripiena delle feste imolesi, cotta: A filled pasta for festive days in Imola, cooked in broth. Small and delicate, they are served in hot broth with parmesan.
Pasta ripiena di carne, bietola e pane,: Pasta filled with meat, chard and bread, dressed with meat ragù. They are served hot with the ragù and parmesan: the festive first course of the Lucca area.
Pasta ripiena di carne, pane, amaretti e: Pasta filled with meat, bread, amaretti and raisins, with butter, sage and pancetta. A sweet-and-savoury filling, closed like a sweet wrapper: they are served with melted butter and sage.
Pasta ripiena dolce-salata con amaretti,: Sweet-and-savoury filled pasta with amaretti, mostaccino, raisins and citron. They are served with melted butter, sage and grana: it is the festive dish of Crema.
Pasta sfoglia al burro con crema al latt: Butter puff pastry with milk custard and a pastry lattice, baked in the oven.
Pasta sfoglia con zucchine e cipolla sal: Puff pastry with sautéed courgettes and onion, bound with eggs and béchamel and topped with cheese.
Pasta sfoglia con zucchine saltate, rico: Puff pastry with sautéed courgettes, ricotta, egg, Parmigiano and pancetta.
Pasta sfoglia farcita con peperoni salta: Puff pastry filled with sautéed peppers, tuna and cream cheese.
Pasta tirata sottilissima arrotolata su: Paper-thin stretched pastry rolled around apples, raisins, pine nuts and cinnamon. It is served warm, in slices, with icing sugar and, if you like, cream or vanilla sauce.
Pastella di farina di castagne con acini: A chestnut-flour batter with zibibbo grapes, fried and sugared.
Pastella di farina e latte cotta al forn: A batter of flour and milk baked in a buttered pan until golden.
Pastella di farina, latte, tuorli e albu: A batter of flour, milk, yolks and whisked whites, baked for an hour in butter.
Pasticcini di mollica bagnata nel brodo,: Little pastries of breadcrumb soaked in broth, filled with a sweetbread ragù, fried.
Pasticcini di pasta sfoglia ripieni di z: Little puff pastries filled with candied squash and orange zest, baked in the oven.
Pasticcini genovesi di frolla ripieni di: Genoese shortcrust tartlets filled with custard with pistachios, pine nuts and candied fruit.
Pasticcini soffici di uova montate, zucc: Soft little cakes of whisked eggs, sugar and chocolate, baked in paper cases.
Pastinache lessate e condite con olio, s: Parsnips boiled and dressed with oil, salt and fennel seeds pounded in vinegar.
Pastine di frolla alle mandorle tostate,: Little shortcrust biscuits with toasted almonds, rolled with the ridged rolling pin.
Patate a cubetti rosolate in padella con: Diced potatoes browned in a pan with stewed cavolo nero, boiled chickpeas, garlic and rosemary.
Patate a dadini cotte nel soffritto di l: Diced potatoes cooked in a soffritto of lard and onion until they fall apart, with bread.
Patate a pezzi cotte nel brodo con prezz: Potato chunks cooked in broth with parsley and finished in butter, without browning.
Patate al vapore a fette grosse, con oli: Steamed potatoes in thick slices, with oil and vinegar or with Genoese agliata.
Patate crude a fette sottili rosolate ne: Thinly sliced raw potatoes browned in butter, the classic side for steak.
Patate della Sila cotte in padella con c: Sila potatoes cooked in the frying pan with onion until they stick together and form a crust. They are served hot, in wedges, with the golden crust.
Patate e bietole lessate e passate, impa: Potatoes and chard boiled and puréed, mixed with eggs, ricotta, Parmigiano and marjoram and baked in a dish.
Patate e peperoni fritti insieme in pade: Potatoes and peppers fried together in the frying pan, each family with its own version. Soft and a little crisp at the edges: they are eaten hot, also in a roll.
Patate in umido con grasso di manzo, bur: Potatoes stewed with beef fat, butter, garlic, rosemary and tomato.
Patate incise a ventaglio arrostite con: Potatoes cut into fans and roasted with white and green asparagus, king oyster mushrooms and cherry tomatoes, served with a chive yoghurt sauce.
Patate intere, costine, salamini e pance: Whole potatoes, spare ribs, small salamis and pancetta cooked for two hours in alpine-pasture butter.
Patate lessate e passate, lavorate a fuo: Potatoes boiled and puréed, worked over a low heat with butter and milk.
Patate lesse a fette rosolate nello stru: Sliced boiled potatoes browned in lard with plenty of onion, until crusty.
Patate lesse pestate con funghi, aglio,: Boiled potatoes mashed with mushrooms, garlic, prescinseua and Parmigiano, baked in the oven.
Patate novelle con la buccia cotte in fo: New potatoes in their skins baked with rosemary, thyme, sage and garlic.
Patate novelle piccole rosolate intere n: Small new potatoes browned whole in butter and finished with parsley.
Patate schiacciate col burro e il latte,: Potatoes mashed with butter and milk, baked in a pan until crusty.
Patate svuotate, ripiene di vitello e an: Hollowed-out potatoes, stuffed with veal and sweetbread and cooked in meat sauce.
Pecora bollita a lungo con patate, cipol: Mutton boiled for a long time with potatoes, onions and sun-dried tomatoes. A shepherds' one-dish meal: the broth is served first and then the meat with the vegetables.
Pecora bollita a lungo con patate, pomod: Mutton boiled for a long time with potatoes, tomatoes and herbs, a dish of the transhumance. Very tender meat in its savoury broth: it is served hot, the shepherds' one-dish meal.
Pecora cotta per ore nel paiolo di rame: Mutton cooked for hours in the copper cauldron with herbs and chilli. Very tender meat in its savoury broth: it is served hot.
Pelare e cuocere le patate, passarle e t: Peel and cook the potatoes, pass them and keep them warm.
Penne cotte nel brodo delle alzavole e c: Penne cooked in the broth of teal and dressed with their meat, butter and parmesan.
Penne integrali in una salsa dolce e spe: Wholemeal penne in a sweet, spiced sauce of onion, green apple and curry, with crunchy edamame and mint.
Peperoni lunghi ripieni di patate, uova: Long peppers stuffed with potatoes, eggs and pecorino, fried.
Peperoni sott'aceto, cetriolo, melanzane: Pickled peppers, cucumber, aubergines, tomatoes and raw onion in a salad.
Pere cotte piano nel vino rosso con limo: Pears cooked slowly in red wine with lemon, cinnamon, cloves and raisins, served with almonds and crumbled amaretti.
Pere intere cotte piano nel vino bianco: Whole pears cooked slowly in white wine with sugar, cinnamon and lemon.
Perine sbucciate cotte in uno sciroppo l: Small peeled pears cooked in a light lemon syrup, served cold.
Pernice in crosta con farcia di fegatini: Partridge in pastry with a stuffing of chicken livers, truffle and tongue: it is served cold.
Pernici arrostite allo spiedo e unte d'o: Partridges roasted on the spit and brushed with oil, wrapped in ham if you like.
Pernici arrosto finite in una salsa di v: Roast partridges finished in a sauce of white wine, sieved carcasses and truffle.
Pernici lardellate e fasciate di vitello: Partridges larded and wrapped in veal and ham, braised for two hours in wine.
Pernici rosolate nel burro e servite con: Partridges browned in butter and served with a side of spinach.
Pesce bollito negli odori e servito con: Fish boiled with aromatics and served with beetroot, potatoes and hard-boiled eggs.
Pesce cotto in tegame tra due fuochi con: Fish cooked in a dish between two fires with oil, garlic, parsley and dried mushrooms.
Pesce intero cotto sulla brace in una ca: Whole fish cooked over embers in a paper case brushed with oil and lemon.
Pesce lesso sfilettato in balsamella con: Boiled fish, filleted, in béchamel with parmesan, browned under breadcrumbs.
Pesce minuto cotto in un piatto da forno: Small fish baked in a dish with garlic, parsley, lemon and wine.
Pesce spada arrotolato su pangrattato, p: Swordfish rolled round breadcrumbs, pine nuts, raisins and caciocavallo, grilled over embers. Tasting of the grill and of the sweet-and-sour filling: they are served hot with lemon.
Pesche duracine sbucciate cotte piano ne: Peeled clingstone peaches cooked slowly in white wine with sugar and a splash of rum.
Pesche farcite di mandorle, biscotti al: Peaches stuffed with almonds, Marsala biscuits and candied squash, baked with butter.
Petti di pollo con pinoli e piselli, leg: Chicken breasts with pine nuts and peas, bound with yolks and lemon, Genoese-style.
Petto di pollo arrosto pestato con mando: Roast chicken breast pounded with almonds and breadcrumb, dissolved in broth over bread.
Petto di vitello aperto a libro e farcit: Breast of veal opened out like a book and stuffed with meat, prosciutto and mortadella, cooked in a pan.
Petto di vitello con le ossa steccato al: Breast of veal on the bone studded with prosciutto, roasted with lard and potatoes.
Petto di vitello di latte in umido col b: Breast of milk-fed veal stewed with a battuto of aromatics, finished with fennel in butter.
Petto di vitello lessato partendo da acq: Veal breast boiled from cold water, with parsley in oil.
Petto e ali di tacchino lessati con radi: Turkey breast and wings boiled with roots, herbs and a battuto of lard.
Pezzetti di pasta di pane lievitata, fri: Pieces of yeasted bread dough, fried and eaten hot, salted or with sugar.
Pezzetti di sedano lessati, saltati nel: Small pieces of celery boiled, tossed in butter and bound with béchamel and parmesan.
Pezzi d'agnello lessati a metà, passati: Pieces of lamb half boiled, dipped in egg and breadcrumbs and fried in lard.
Pezzi d'anguilla infarinati con la salvi: Pieces of eel floured with sage, cooked without fat with vinegar and plenty of pepper.
Pezzi di baccalà infarinati e fritti, co: Pieces of salt cod floured and fried, covered with a sauce of garlic, bread and vinegar.
Pezzi di cardo farciti di cardo, funghi,: Pieces of cardoon filled with cardoon, mushrooms, eggs and Parmigiano, cooked in a dish.
Pezzi di castrato rosolati nel burro e l: Pieces of mutton browned in butter and lard with onions and cloves.
Pezzi di palombo nel soffritto d'aglio e: Pieces of smooth-hound in a soffritto of garlic and parsley, cooked with wine and tomato.
Pezzi di pollo disossato impanati, rosol: Pieces of boned chicken, breaded, browned and finished in a sauce made with the bones.
Pezzi di stoccafisso ammollato passati i: Pieces of soaked stockfish dipped in a water and flour batter and fried.
Pezzo di lesso finito in umido col battu: A piece of boiled beef finished as a stew with the battuto, tomato and dried mushrooms.
Piadina calda farcita con salmone affumi: Hot piadina filled with smoked salmon, lettuce and a fresh sauce of Greek yoghurt, rocket, lemon and chives.
Piadina sfogliata con strutto, farcita d: A flaky flatbread made with lard, filled with wild greens or cured meats. Flaky and crumbly: it is eaten hot, just cooked on the testo.
Piccione allo spiedo con dentro una brac: Spit-roasted pigeon with a beaten veal escalope inside, with butter and spices.
Piccione aperto, scottato nell'olio, pas: Pigeon opened out, seared in oil, dipped in butter, egg and breadcrumbs and grilled.
Piccioni a pezzi con prosciutto, animell: Pigeons in pieces with prosciutto, sweetbreads and mushrooms, bound with butter and lemon.
Piccioni arrostiti in casseruola col bur: Pigeons roasted in a casserole with butter, or on the spit brushed with oil.
Piccioni con la salvia rosolati sul pros: Pigeons with sage browned on prosciutto, cooked with broth and served on bread.
Piccioni cotti al vapore per due ore in: Pigeons steamed for two hours in a closed container over the boiling pot.
Piccioni in casseruola con tartufi, fega: Pigeons in a casserole with truffles, chicken livers, sweetbread, herbs and white wine.
Piccioni in umido con cipolla e prosciut: Pigeons stewed with onion and prosciutto, surrounded by peas cooked in their sauce.
Piccola pasta di semola tostata cotta co: A small toasted semolina pasta cooked like a risotto with arselle (clams) and tomato. A thick soup tasting of the sea: it is served hot, with its juices.
Piccola pasta ripiena di stracotto e sal: Small pasta filled with slow-braised beef and salami, served in capon broth. Small and delicate, they are served in hot broth: the festive first course of Mantua.
Piccole lumache di mare dell'Alto Adriat: Small sea snails of the northern Adriatic stewed with tomato, to be picked out with a cocktail stick and served with crostini or polenta.
Piccole ricotte intere, impanate con pan: Small whole ricottas, coated in herb breadcrumbs and baked on a bed of leeks and carrots.
Piccole ricotte sode passate più volte n: Small firm ricottas rolled several times in sugar, then in flour and egg, fried and dusted with cinnamon: a hot sweet of the Neapolitan home.
Piccoli cavoli farciti di vitello, ricot: Small cabbages stuffed with veal, ricotta and marjoram, cooked in broth on bread.
Piccoli fagioli dal colore variabile, le: Small beans of varying colour, boiled and dressed with new oil. Delicate and thin-skinned: they are served warm as a side dish.
Piccoli flan di spinaci, ricotta e parmi: Little flans of spinach, ricotta and Parmigiano, steamed and served with a Fontina fonduta.
Piccoli pancake di fiocchi d'avena e mir: Small oat and blueberry pancakes stacked in towers, with sweetened ricotta and strawberries between the layers.
Piccoli pani tondi cotti negli stampi, d: Small round breads cooked in moulds, to be filled with Modena-style lard pesto. They are split open while still hot and filled; they are eaten with cured meats and cheeses.
Piccoli sformati di orzo mantecato con a: Small timbales of barley finished with asiago and chives, served on a sauce of red radicchio and cream.
Piedi di vitello lessati due ore col les: Calf's feet boiled for two hours with the boiled meat, boned and dressed as a salad.

Polpa di aragosta lessa con lattuga, uov: Boiled lobster meat with lettuce, hard-boiled eggs, anchovies, capers and gherkins.
Polpa di banane mature passata con limon: Ripe banana pulp puréed with lemon and syrup, frozen in the ice-cream maker.
Polpa di castagne con tuorli montati, ru: Chestnut purée with whisked yolks, rum and stiff egg whites, dusted with chocolate.
Polpa di pesche mature con sciroppo prof: Ripe peach pulp with a syrup scented with bitter almond and lemon.
Polpa di stoccafisso ammollato sminuzzat: Flaked flesh of soaked stockfish in batter, fried in spoonfuls.
Polpa di zucca al forno lavorata con bur: Oven-baked pumpkin flesh worked with butter, eggs, lemon and almonds, in a cake tin.

Polpette al forno di sgombro tritato con: Baked balls of minced mackerel with cashews, lemon, garlic, parsley and breadcrumbs, without eggs.

Polpette di lesso brasato con pinoli e u: Meatballs of braised boiled beef with pine nuts and raisins, breadcrumbed and fried on Shrove Tuesday.
Polpette di patate, uova e parmigiano, i: Croquettes of potato, eggs and Parmigiano, breaded and browned in butter.
Polpette di tonno, ceci frullati e patat: Patties of tuna, blended chickpeas and boiled potato with capers, anchovy and parsley, baked in the oven.

Polpette schiacciate di purè di patate,: Flattened patties of mashed potato, carrots and peas with eggs and parmesan, coated in breadcrumbs and baked in the oven.
Polpette vegetali senza uova: cous cous: Egg-free vegetable patties: couscous and peas blended with parsley, cooked in a pan or in the oven.

Polpettine di ceci frullati con basilico: Little balls of blended chickpeas with basil, parsley, seeds and lemon zest, breaded and baked instead of fried.
Polpettine di pollo tritato con uova, pa: Little meatballs of minced chicken with eggs, breadcrumbs and parmesan baked in the oven, served with boiled celery and carrots.

Polpettine di semolino al latte con mand: Little patties of semolina cooked in milk with pounded almonds, breaded and fried.
Polpettine di vitello e animelle dorate: Little veal and sweetbread meatballs browned in a pan and served in broth on bread.

Polpettone vegetale di lenticchie, carot: A vegetable loaf of lentils, carrots and onion chopped with breadcrumbs and herbs, rolled up and baked in the oven.

Purè di piselli secchi col soffritto al: A purée of dried peas with a soffritto of butter and tomato, served with croutons.

Quadretti di cervello e besciamella soda: Squares of brains and firm béchamel, breaded and fried in lard.

Ranocchi cotti col pomodoro e passati, c: Frogs cooked with tomato and sieved, with the legs boned and mushrooms, over bread.

Ravioli genovesi di pollo, piccione, vit: Genoese ravioli of chicken, pigeon, veal and borage, with veal sauce.

Rice cooked in milk with butter and Parmigiano, bound with yolks: a runny risotto.

Soffriggere nell'olio le cipolle tagliat: Suffer the onions cut into rounds in a large saucepan in the oil.
Soffriggere nell'olio, col lardo, aglio,: Suffer in oil, with lard, garlic, the rest of the onion and celery.
Soffriggere patate e cipolle in padella: Sauté potatoes and onions in a pan with oil, salt and rosemary.
Soffriggere scalogno e lardo battuto con: Suffer shallots and baked lard with a little oil, occasionally adding a drop of water.
Soffriggere uno spicchio d'aglio nell'ol: Suffer a clove of garlic in the oil, add the passata, basil and salt.
Soffriggerle in un tegame capiente con o: Suffer them in a large pan with oil and chilli.
Soffriggerli nell'olio con aglio e prezz: Suffer them in oil with chopped garlic and parsley, salt and pepper.
Soffriggerli nell'olio con lo spicchio d: Suffer them in oil with garlic clove and some salt.
Sogliola cotta piano tra due piatti con: Sole cooked slowly between two plates with parsley, spring onion and dried mushrooms.
Sogliole fritte in agrodolce di aceto, s: Fried sole in a sweet and sour sauce of vinegar, sapa, sage, pine nuts, raisins and candied peel.
Sogliole grosse unte di lardo, impanate: Large soles brushed with lard, breadcrumbed and cooked on the grill.
Sorbetto di agrumi con meringa all'itali: A citrus sorbet with Italian meringue and rum, served in small glasses.
Sorbetto di lamponi passati, limone e sc: A sorbet of puréed raspberries, lemon and syrup, with an intense fragrance.
Sorbetto di sciroppo e succo di limone,: A sorbet of syrup and lemon juice, sharp and scented with the zest.
Sorbetto di succo d'arancia e limone con: A sorbet of orange and lemon juice with syrup, served in small stemmed glasses.
Sottile torta di ceci, servita a Livorno: A thin chickpea cake, served in Livorno in the «5 e 5» with focaccia. Crisp on top and soft inside, it is eaten hot, with black pepper.
Sottili cialde di farina di castagne cot: Thin chestnut-flour wafers cooked between two hot testi, sweet or savoury.
Sottili frittatine di latte, farina e uo: Thin little omelettes of milk, flour and eggs, sugared and rolled up.
Soufflé di farina di mais cotta nel latt: A soufflé of maize flour cooked in milk with butter, sugar and whisked whites.
Soufflé dolce di besciamella alle mandor: A sweet soufflé of béchamel with pounded almonds and vanilla sugar.
Soufflé dolce di fecola di patate cotta: A sweet soufflé of potato starch cooked in milk, scented with lemon.
Spaghetti all'olio conditi con un pesto: Spaghetti with oil dressed with a pesto of walnuts, breadcrumbs, sugar and spices.
Spaghetti col battuto di tonno sott'olio: Spaghetti with a battuto of tuna in oil and anchovies fried with onion.
Spaghetti col sugo di naselli passati, a: Spaghetti with a sauce of sieved hake, with tomato, butter and marsala.
Spaghetti col sugo passato di pomodori,: Spaghetti with a sieved sauce of tomatoes, garlic, parsley and basil, and parmesan.
Spaghetti con guanciale croccante, tuorl: Spaghetti with crisp guanciale, egg yolks, pecorino romano and black pepper. Creamy without cream, with crisp guanciale and plenty of pepper: serve it at once, hot.
Spaghetti con olio, aglio e bottarga di: Spaghetti with oil, garlic and grated grey mullet bottarga. A bold taste of the sea: it is served at once, with more grated bottarga on top.
Spaghetti con pomodorini, peperoncino e: Spaghetti with cherry tomatoes, chilli and plenty of cheese, a Monday dish. Red and stringy with cheese: it is served at once, hot.
Spaghetti con punte e rondelle di aspara: Spaghetti with asparagus tips and rounds, peas and pecorino, coloured by saffron dissolved in the asparagus water.
Spaghetti con scampi o gamberi in sugo d: Spaghetti with scampi or prawns in a sauce of tomato, white wine and chilli. A red, slightly spicy sauce: it is served at once, with the shellfish whole.
Spaghetti con vongole veraci, aglio, oli: Spaghetti with carpet-shell clams, garlic, oil, parsley and chilli. They are served at once: the clam juices bind the pasta.
Spaghetti con zucchine fritte e provolon: Spaghetti with fried courgettes and provolone del Monaco stirred in until creamy. Creamy and scented with basil: it is served at once, a summer dish of the Amalfi Coast.
Spaghetti cotti 'risottati' nel sugo di: Spaghetti cooked like a risotto in hot tomato sauce until scorched. Hot and a little crisp: they are served at once, hot.
Spaghetti di farro conditi con una crema: Spelt spaghetti dressed with a cream of asparagus stalks and onion, stewed and blended, plus the blanched tips.
Spaghetti di farro saltati in una crema: Spelt spaghetti tossed in a smoked provola cream with asparagus pieces and fried shallot.
Spaghetti di magro con acciughe sciolte: Meatless spaghetti with anchovies melted in oil and butter and a little tomato.
Spaghetti di magro con mollica tostata,: Meatless spaghetti with toasted breadcrumbs, anchovies and capers, for San Giuseppe (19 March). Crunchy with breadcrumbs and savoury: it is served at once, hot.
Spaghetti di magro conditi con cipolle f: Meatless spaghetti dressed with onions browned to red in oil.
Spaghetti spezzati conditi coi piselli f: Broken spaghetti dressed with fresh peas cooked with a battuto of carnesecca.
Spaghettoni a sezione quadrata tagliati: Square-section thick spaghetti cut with the troccolaturo, with tomato sauce. Thick, porous pasta that holds the sauce: it is served hot with pecorino.
Spaghettoni tirati a mano con sugo di po: Hand-rolled thick spaghetti with a sauce of tomato and Valdichiana aglione. Thick, irregular pasta and a sauce scented with garlic but delicate: it is served with pecorino.
Spalla d'agnello infarinata, rosolata ne: Floured shoulder of lamb, browned in butter and cooked slowly, moistened with milk.
Spalla di capretto rosolata in forno e f: Shoulder of kid browned in the oven and finished with broth, tomato sauce and rosemary.
Spalla di maiale all'aglio cotta due ore: Garlic shoulder of pork cooked for two hours on vegetables and herbs, moistened with strong vinegar.
Spalla di maiale lessata con cipolle, al: Shoulder of pork boiled with onions, bay and vinegar, served with its juices and horseradish.
Spalla di vitello arrostita al forno nel: Shoulder of veal roasted in the oven in butter and lard, basted with its juices.
Spalla disossata e lardellata, cotta tre: A boned, larded shoulder, cooked slowly for three hours with brandy and tomato.
Spennellare con il tuorlo sbattuto e cuo: Brush with beaten yolk and bake in the oven at 180 °C for 40 minutes until the surface is golden.
Spennellare con l'uovo sbattuto e cuocer: Brush with beaten egg and bake in the oven at 220 °C for 15-20 minutes.
Spessi tagliolini di acqua e farina con: Thick tagliolini of water and flour with a sauce of garlic, oil and chilli. A thick, chewy pasta, a spicy, simple sauce: it is served at once.
Spezzare gli ziti e lessarli in acqua bo: Break the ziti and boil them in boiling salted water.
Spezzatino di vitello al burro con cipol: Veal stew in butter with small onions, potatoes, carrots, turnips and broccoli.
Spezzatino di vitello al burro e cipolla: Veal stew with butter and onion, bound with yolks, parsley and lemon.
Spicchi di carciofo e asparagi cotti poc: Artichoke wedges and asparagus cooked for a few minutes in the frying pan with garlic, oil and mint: tender but crunchy.
Spicchi di carciofo infarinati, passati: Wedges of artichoke floured, dipped in egg and fried without batter, with lemon.
Spicchi di carciofo infarinati, rosolati: Wedges of artichoke floured, browned with garlic and nepitella and finished with tomato.
Spicchi di carciofo stufati nel burro e: Artichoke wedges stewed in butter and bound with yolks, lemon and Parmigiano.
Spicchi di cavolfiore lessati e ripassat: Cauliflower wedges boiled and tossed with anchovies, meat sauce and capers.
Spicchi di cavolo cappuccio scottati e c: Wedges of white cabbage scalded and cooked slowly in a sauce of prosciutto and onion.
Spicchi di finocchio lessati, infarinati: Wedges of fennel boiled, floured and fried in a light batter.
Spicchi di finocchio scottati, cotti nel: Fennel wedges blanched, cooked in butter and broth and finished with parmesan.
Spicchi di mela cotogna cotti nello scir: Wedges of quince cooked in syrup and served cold in their reduced juice.
Spicchi di pesca con la buccia fritti in: Wedges of unpeeled peach fried in batter and covered with sugar.
Spiedini di carne di pecora cotti sulla: Skewers of mutton cooked on the «canala» over embers. Small cubes of meat and fat, full of the flavour of the embers: they are eaten by the dozen, with bread and oil.
Spiedini di vitello, fegato, animelle, c: Skewers of veal, liver, sweetbreads, artichoke and sage, breaded and fried.
Spinaci al magro con pinoli rosolati, ag: Meatless spinach with browned pine nuts, garlic and raisins, served with fried croutons.
Spinaci col soffritto di funghi e pinoli: Spinach with a soffritto of mushrooms and pine nuts in broth, on fried bread and yolks.
Spinaci cotti adagio nel burro con farin: Spinach cooked slowly in butter with flour and cream, creamy, to garnish boiled meats.
Spinaci lessati e ripassati nel burro, c: Spinach boiled and tossed in butter, enclosed in a four-egg omelette.
Spinaci lessati e tritati fini, insapori: Spinach boiled and finely chopped, flavoured in butter with a little cream and parmesan.
Spinaci lessati, tritati grossi e ripass: Spinach boiled, roughly chopped and tossed with garlic, oil and a little pepper.
Spinaci nel burro legati con uova, parmi: Spinach in butter bound with eggs, Parmigiano and marjoram, served with croutons.
Spinaci passati con besciamella, uova, c: Sieved spinach with béchamel, eggs, cinnamon and raisins, filled with giblets.
Spinaci ripassati nel burro con pinoli e: Spinach tossed in butter with pine nuts and raisins, a Genoese side for boiled meats and eggs.
Spirale di pasta lievitata ripiena di no: A spiral of leavened dough filled with walnuts, raisins, pine nuts and grappa. It is served in slices, often soaked with grappa or slivovitz: it is the festive cake of Friuli.
Stampini foderati di sarde aperte a libr: Small moulds lined with butterflied sardines and filled with barley, courgette and carrot, baked and served on a tomato sauce.
Starne arrostite nella carta con cipolla: Grey partridges roasted in paper with onion, bay and oil, basted with their own fat.
Stecchini di fegatini, groviera e lingua: Skewers of chicken livers, gruyère and tongue coated in béchamel, breadcrumbed and fried.
Stecchini freschi che alternano cubetti: Fresh skewers alternating cubes of melon, primosale and cucumber with basil leaves: sweet and savoury together.
Stendere 2-3 cucchiai di crema sul fondo: Spread 2-3 tablespoons of cream on the bottom of a baking dish of about 20×30 cm.
Stendere due terzi della frolla a 4 mm e: Roll out two-thirds of the 4 mm short and cover a 22 cm buttered cake tin.
Stendere due terzi della frolla e fodera: Roll out two thirds of the short and cover a pan of 24 cm.
Stendere due terzi della frolla in una t: Spread two thirds of the shorts in a 22 cm baking pan, pierce them and spread the apricot jam.
Stendere la frolla in una teglia di circ: Spread the shorts in a pan of about 24 cm.
Stendere la frolla in uno stampo da 22 c: Spread the shorts in a 22 cm mold and pierce them.
Stendere la pasta reale a 1 cm e foderar: Roll out the royal dough to 1 cm and cover in half a lamb shaped mold (or shape by hand two half of 20 cm lying lamb).
Stenderla alta mezzo centimetro in uno s: Spread it half an inch high in a 24 cm tart mold, pierce the bottom, cover with baking paper and dried legumes.
Stiacciata di manzo e prosciutto tritati: A flat patty of minced beef and prosciutto, cooked in a pan with rosemary and tomato.
Stinco di vitello brasato, con gremolada: Braised veal shank, with a gremolada of lemon, garlic and parsley. It is served with risotto alla milanese; the marrow is eaten with a teaspoon.
Stoccafisso ammollato e cotto adagio in: Stockfish soaked and cooked slowly in a pan with oil, garlic and pepper.
Stoccafisso ammollato, lessato e condito: Soaked stockfish, boiled and dressed with oil, lemon, salt and pepper.
Stoccafisso con patate, olive, capperi e: Stockfish with potatoes, olives, capers and chilli, a speciality of Mammola. Savoury and a little hot: it is served hot, with its sauce.
Stoccafisso cotto lentamente con patate,: Stockfish cooked slowly with potatoes, tomato, olives and Verdicchio. Tender and full of flavour, it is served hot with its sauce.
Stoccafisso lessato e montato con olio f: Stockfish boiled and beaten with oil into a cream, on toasted polenta. White and fluffy, it is spread on polenta crostini: an antipasto of the Venetian bàcari (wine bars).
Stoccafisso stufato con acciughe, aglio,: Stockfish stewed with anchovies, garlic, pine nuts, spices and white wine.
Stoccafisso stufato con bietole, soffrit: Stockfish stewed with chard, an aromatic soffritto and tomato, Genoese-style.
Stoccafisso stufato tre ore in olio, agl: Stockfish stewed for three hours in oil, garlic, parsley and tomato, with potatoes.
Strati di acciughe fresche e patate al f: Layers of fresh anchovies and potatoes baked with garlic, parsley and tomato. It is served hot, in the pan, with bread for the sauce.
Strati di aringhe dissalate nel latte e: Layers of herrings desalted in milk and boiled potatoes, with garlic, cheese and tomato.
Strati di fettine di vitello al parmigia: Layers of thin veal slices with parmesan cooked on lard, served on spinach.
Strati di melanzane fritte, sugo di pomo: Layers of fried aubergines, tomato sauce, fiordilatte, basil and Parmigiano. It is served warm or at room temperature, in squares: it is better the next day.
Strati di patate, tartufo e parmigiano a: Layers of potatoes, truffle and parmesan in butter, moistened with broth and lemon.
Strati di scrippelle (crespelle) con pol: Layers of scrippelle (crêpes) with little meatballs, mozzarella, artichokes and ragù. Tall and rich, it is served hot in slices: it is the festive dish of Teramo.
Strati di sfoglia, zucchine, carote e ci: Layers of pasta sheets, sautéed courgettes, carrots and onion, béchamel with nutmeg, Parmigiano and scamorza.
Strisce di pasta lievitata fritte e serv: Strips of leavened dough fried and served hot with zabaione: the Carnival sweet of the Val Polcevera.
Strisce di trota e lavarello fritte in t: Strips of trout and lavaret fried in three flours, with orange mayonnaise.
Strisce di zucca secca cotte nel brodo c: Strips of dried squash cooked in broth with tripe, sausage, mushrooms and cardoons.
Striscioline di carota passate in farina: Thin strips of carrot coated in flour and breadcrumbs and browned in a pan, served with rocket.
Striscioline di petto di pollo alla pias: Strips of griddled chicken breast with blanched agretti, carrots, celery and olives, dressed with oil and lemon.
Striscioline di seppia saltate a fuoco v: Strips of cuttlefish stir-fried over a high heat with artichokes, mushrooms, fennel, carrots and tomatoes, deglazed with vinegar and sugar and finished with capers and almonds.
Strudel salato marchigiano: sfoglia sott: A savoury Marche strudel: very thin pastry rolled around wild greens sautéed with garlic and baked.
Stufato invernale di tagli poveri di mai: A winter stew of humble cuts of pork and Savoy cabbage, served with polenta. Thick and full of flavour, slow-cooked: it is the Milanese winter dish, when the cabbage has been touched by frost.
Su un piano cosparso di zucchero a velo: On a plane sprinkled with powdered sugar form a cord of 4 cm of diameter and cut it into pieces of 2 cm.
Succo di visciole alla cannella gelato,: Frozen sour-cherry juice with cinnamon, with sour cherries in syrup stirred in.
Sugo di pomodoro cotto lentissimo con gr: Tomato sauce cooked very slowly with large pieces of meat and braciole. Dark and thick after hours of cooking: the sauce dresses the pasta, the meat is the Sunday main course.
Tacchino arrosto al forno col burro, rip: Roast turkey in the oven with butter, stuffed with chestnuts, sausage and chicken livers.
Tacchino con cipolle e garofani, coperto: Turkey with onions and cloves, covered with lard and lemon and roasted in paper.
Tacchino cucito in un telo con macis, li: Turkey sewn into a cloth with mace, lemon and ham, poached in wine and served cold.
Tagliare a dadini i pomodori datterini e: Cut the cherry tomatoes into cubes and sauté them in another pan with garlic, oil and chilli.
Tagliare a metà per traverso le mandorle: Cut in half through the peeled sweet almonds and dry 10 minutes in the oven at 100 °C.
Tagliare il pane a fette sottili e tosta: Cut the bread into thin slices and toast slightly in the oven or frying pan.
Tagliare il pane in cassetta a rombi, to: Cut the bread into diamond boxes, toast and spread the filling over and under.
Tagliare il pane integrale a fette e tos: Slice the wholemeal bread and toast it in the oven or on the griddle for 4-5 minutes.
Tagliare l'agnello a pezzetti e rosolarl: Cut the lamb into small pieces and brown it in oil.
Tagliare la carne a cubetti di 3-4 cm e: Cut the meat into 3-4 cm cubes and brown from all sides.
Tagliare sottile la cipolla e rosolarla: Cut the onion thinly and brown gently in the butter, then remove it.
Tagliare zucchine e melanzane a listarel: Cut zucchini and eggplant into strips and fry them in hot extra virgin olive oil, then dry them on absorbent paper.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con asparagi al bur: Egg tagliatelle with asparagus in butter, morels stewed for a long time with shallot and flakes of hard-boiled egg.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con asparagi sbolle: Egg tagliatelle with asparagus blanched and then sautéed with shallot, bound with grana and cooking water.
Tagliatelle all'uovo con ragù di manzo e: Egg tagliatelle with a long-cooked ragù of beef and pancetta. The long-cooked, thick ragù coats the rough tagliatelle: they are served with grated parmesan.
Tagliatelle corte di semola fatte in cas: Short home-made semolina tagliatelle cooked with boiled chickpeas, garlic, bay leaf and chilli.
Tagliatelle di grano saraceno con patate: Buckwheat tagliatelle with potatoes, Savoy cabbage, garlic butter and Casera cheese. A hearty mountain dish, buttery and stringy: it is served piping hot, freshly made.
Tagliatelle lunghe all'uovo con sugo di: Long egg tagliatelle with a garlic tomato sauce, butter and parmesan.
Tagliatelle lunghe impastate con gli spi: Long tagliatelle made with spinach in the dough, dressed simply with butter and cheese.
Taglierini all'uovo fatti in casa condit: Homemade egg taglierini dressed with stewed beef sauce and Parmigiano.
Homemade egg taglierini dressed with garlic and basil pesto and Parmigiano.
Taglierini all'uovo rivoltati nel piatto: Egg taglierini tossed on a hot dish with fresh butter and plenty of Parmigiano.
Taglierini impastati con borragine, parm: Taglierini kneaded with borage, Parmigiano and sausage, dressed with veal sauce.
Taglierini sottili di pasta all'uovo fat: Thin taglierini of home-made egg pasta, cooked in meat broth.
Taglierini sottili di semola e uova cott: Thin taglierini of semolina and eggs cooked in a clear beef broth.
Tagliolini cotti nel brodo di ossa di ma: Tagliolini cooked in pork-bone broth and finished in a baking tin in layers with lard, pecorino and breadcrumbs, until the broth is absorbed and they turn crisp.
Tagliolini di semola, acqua e sale con f: Thin noodles of semolina, water and salt with beans: «poor man's meat». Simple and nourishing: it is eaten hot, in bowls.
Tagliolini sottili ai tuorli con burro,: Thin egg-yolk tagliolini with butter, Parmigiano and shaved white truffle. Very thin yellow pasta, barely dressed: the star is the scent of autumn truffle.
Tarallo dolce glassato con zucchero e al: A sweet tarallo glazed with sugar and egg white. White and glossy with icing, it is served at the end of the meal.
Teglia a strati di patate, riso crudo, c: A layered bake of potatoes, raw rice, opened mussels, tomato and pecorino. It is served warm, in the dish: a typical dish of Bari.
Telline sgusciate nel soffritto d'odori: Shelled tellins in a soffritto of aromatics and dried mushrooms, with their water, over bread.
Tenere il brodo caldo su fuoco minimo; s: Keep the broth warm on minimum heat; heat the Barolo in a saucepan without boiling it.
Keep the broth warm on minimum heat; heat Amarone in a saucepan, without boiling it.
Testina d'agnello tagliata per lungo e s: Lamb's head split lengthways and stewed with garlic, parsley and tomato.
Timballo di anelletti con ragù, piselli,: A timbale of anelletti with ragù, peas, aubergines and caciocavallo. It is served in slices, warm: a festive dish in Palermo.
Tinca a pezzi rosolata con cipolle e odo: Tench in pieces browned with onions and aromatics, stewed and finished with tomato, with polenta.
Tinche dorate in olio con erbe e aglio,: Tench browned in oil with herbs and garlic, dusted with flour and moistened with white wine.
Tinche intere cotte nel sugo delle loro: Whole tench cooked in a sauce made from their heads with tomato, with flavoured chard.
Tirare la sfoglia finissima, foderare un: Pull the thin sheet, cover a buttered baking pan of about 30 cm and pour the mixture about 4 cm high.
Tocchetti di polenta soda a strati con b: Chunks of firm polenta in layers with butter, tomato and parmesan.
Tocchi di baccalà grosso arrostiti sulla: Chunks of thick salt cod roasted over embers, brushed with oil, with lemon and pepper.
Tocchi di baccalà marinati in olio e lim: Chunks of salt cod marinated in oil and lemon and roasted in a dish in the oven.
Togliere il foglio sopra, trasferire que: Remove the sheet above, transfer the sheet below onto a baking pan and cook in the oven at 160 °C for 10-15 minutes.
Tondi di pasta ripieni di brasato, salam: Rounds of pasta filled with braised beef, salami and grana, cooked in the three-meat broth. They are served in hot broth, with grated grana: the festive first course of Cremona.
Tondi di petto di pollo battuti, infilat: Rounds of beaten chicken breast, threaded on a stick, breaded and fried in butter.
Tonno marinato due ore con olio, erbe, g: Tuna marinated for two hours with oil, herbs, clove and lemon, then roasted coated in breadcrumbs.
Torta a sfoglie sottili all'olio con spi: A pie of thin oiled pastry layers with spinach tossed in butter and Parmigiano.
Torta a sfoglie sottili all'olio ripiena: A pie of thin oiled pastry layers filled with onions, dried mushrooms and Parmigiano.
A pie of thin oiled pastry layers filled with mushrooms sautéed with garlic and oregano.
Torta a strati di tagliolini sottili, ma: A layered cake of thin tagliolini, almonds, sugar and butter, soaked with rosolio.
Torta al cioccolato fondente con crostic: A dark chocolate cake with a thin crust and a creamy heart. Low, with a thin crust and an almost raw interior: it is served with icing sugar.
Torta alta di farina di riso, nocciole e: A tall cake of rice flour, hazelnuts and almonds, scented with vanilla.
Torta bassa di farina di castagne con pi: A low cake of chestnut flour with pine nuts, raisins, walnuts and rosemary. Moist and dark, barely sweet (there is no sugar): it is served at room temperature, in autumn.
Torta chiusa di pasta di semola e strutt: A closed pie of semolina and strutto pastry filled with eels or lamb with potatoes, garlic and parsley, baked for a long time.
Torta di carote grattugiate con olio ext: A grated carrot cake with extra virgin olive oil and lemon, without butter.
Torta di mele senza glutine, con farina: A gluten-free apple cake, with rice flour, potato starch, brown sugar and seed oil.
Torta di pasta frolla ripiena di carne t: A shortcrust pie filled with minced meat, chocolate, pine nuts, raisins and candied citron.
Torta di riso cotto nel latte, mandorle: A cake of rice cooked in milk, almonds and citron, soaked with liqueur. Dense and moist, it is served cold in small squares, often speared on a cocktail stick.
Torta di uova, zucchero, farina e burro: A cake of eggs, sugar, flour and butter in equal weight, with almonds and lemon.
Torta friabile di farina di mais, mandor: A crumbly cake of maize flour, almonds and lard, to be broken with the hands. It is broken into pieces by hand and served at the end of the meal, perhaps with a sweet wine.
Torta friabile di mandorle sbriciolata,: A crumbly crumbled almond cake, to be broken with the hands. Crumbly and scented with almonds, it is served in pieces with coffee.
Torta genovese soffice di farina di riso: A soft Genoese cake of rice flour, whipped butter, eggs and lemon.
Torta lievitata ripiena di scarola, oliv: A yeasted pie filled with escarole, olives, capers, pine nuts and raisins. It is eaten at room temperature, in slices, the next day too.
Torta rustica di patate e cipolle in teg: A rustic potato and onion pie baked in a tin, without eggs. Low and golden, it is eaten warm or cold, in squares.
Torta rustica pasquale piena di uova, fo: A rustic Easter pie full of eggs, cheeses and cured meats. Tall and very rich, it is eaten in slices, at room temperature, at Easter and on Easter Monday.
Torta salata con base brisée, porri stuf: A savoury tart with a shortcrust base, stewed leeks and slices of boiled potato, bound with egg, milk and Parmigiano.
Torta salata con base brisée, ripieno di: A savoury tart with a shortcrust base, a filling of eggs and ricotta and whole asparagus laid on top like the spokes of a wheel.
Torta salata di bietole e Parmigiano, co: A savoury pie of chard and Parmigiano, with thin pastry and pancetta. It is eaten warm or cold, in squares, also as a snack.
Torta salata di farro IGP, ricotta e par: A savoury tart of IGP spelt, ricotta and parmesan in a shortcrust (brisée) case.
Torta salata di riso, bietole e pecorino: A savoury pie of rice, chard and pecorino, heavily peppered, in thin pastry.
Torta salata sottile ripiena di erbe di: A thin savoury pie filled with wild greens, chard, eggs and cheese. It is eaten warm or cold, in slices, also the next day.
Torta senza burro con farina di grano sa: A cake without butter with buckwheat and almond flour, grated carrots and stiff egg whites, under a sugar icing.
Torta senza farina di noci pestate, cioc: A flourless cake of pounded walnuts, chocolate, whisked eggs and candied citron.
Torta soffice con banane a pezzetti, yog: A soft cake with chopped bananas, yogurt, seed oil and chocolate chips.
Torta soffice con i mandarini frullati i: A soft cake with whole mandarins blended into the batter, seed oil and milk.
Torta soffice di albumi montati, burro e: A soft cake of whisked egg whites, butter and raisins, so as not to waste the whites.

Zuppa di fave fresche, pasta corta, pane: A soup of fresh broad beans, short pasta, toasted rye bread and Fontina, browned in the oven. Stringy and full of flavour: it is served hot, in bowls.

Zuppa di lenticchie con champignon, soff: Lentil soup with button mushrooms, soffritto, a little tomato and bay leaf.
Zuppa di lenticchie di Pietraroja con le: Pietraroja lentil soup with pork rinds, the dish of important lunches.
Zuppa di orzo perlato con champignon, po: Pearl barley soup with button mushrooms, dried porcini and borlotti beans, scented with rosemary.
Zuppa di pane raffermo cotto nell'acqua: A soup of stale bread cooked in water with fried onion and pancetta.
Zuppa di pesce cotta nel tegame di cocci: Fish soup cooked in the earthenware pan with sweet pepper and tomato. It is served in the pan, with toasted bread for the sauce.
Zuppa di pesce di scoglio e «pesce dimen: A soup of rock fish and «forgotten fish» in tomato, on garlic bread.
Zuppa di pesce e crostacei dei pescatori: A fishermen's soup of fish and shellfish, lightly red with tomato, on Tuscan bread.
Zuppa di pesce in bianco, senza pomodoro: A fish soup «in bianco», without tomato, with pepper and vinegar. A clean taste of the sea, a little sharp with vinegar: it is served hot, with bread.
Zuppa di pesce povero dell'Adriatico nat: A soup of humble Adriatic fish born on the fishing boats: a tomato and vinegar sauce in which mixed fish cook, to be eaten with bread.
Zuppa di zucchette con pomodori e pancet: A soup of small courgettes with tomatoes and pancetta, cooked in their own water.
Zuppa povera di ceci, fagioli e farro, c: A humble soup of chickpeas, beans and spelt, with raw oil and pepper. It is served hot, with a drizzle of new oil: it is the poor dish of La Spezia.
Zuppa rustica di pasta fatta in casa a s: A rustic soup of home-made pasta in strips with borlotti beans and tomato. Thick and hot, it is eaten in bowls, with raw oil.
«Collane» di piccole ciambelle di farina: «Necklaces» of small rings of flour, butter, sugar and milk, De.Co. (municipal designation of origin) of Rottofreno: once the godparents' gift to children being confirmed.

Acciughe fresche aperte a libro, farcite: Fresh anchovies opened like a book, stuffed in pairs with fresh pecorino, garlic and parsley, breaded and fried.
