Baccalà ubriaco: tranci di baccalà cotti: Drunk salt cod: steaks of salt cod cooked in dry white wine with onion and bay.
Baccalà, uvetta e pinoli sono una delle: Salt cod, raisins and pine nuts are one of the oldest pairings of southern lean cooking; in Molise it is eaten on Christmas Eve. Ricette Regionali gives it among the first courses.
Bagnè 'n t'l'öli, intingere nell'olio, è: Bagnè 'n t'l'öli, dipping in oil, is the Piedmontese pinzimonio, the cold spring version of bagna càuda; Ricette Regionali gives it without quantities, and the quantities here are ours, for 4 people.
Barbabietole cotte a fette nel vino ross: Beetroot slices cooked in red wine with sugar, vinegar and wild fennel seeds.
Bastoncini croccanti di albumi montati,: Crunchy sticks of whipped egg whites, sugar, chopped almonds and flour, scented with cinnamon and lemon, with chocolate if you like.
Bianchetti, i piccoli di acciuga e sardi: Bianchetti, baby anchovies and sardines, briefly blanched and dressed with oil, lemon, parsley and pepper.
Biete lessate e ripassate in padella con: Chard boiled and sautéed in a pan with oil, melted anchovies and tomatoes in pieces.
Bietole lessate e ripassate in padella c: Swiss chard boiled and then tossed in a pan with garlic and oil, topped with crumbled, toasted stale bread.
Bigoli fatti in casa con un sugo di riga: Homemade bigoli with a sauce of chicken giblets cooked in butter and red wine, finished with parmesan and parsley.
Bigoli freschi con un ragù senza carne d: Fresh bigoli with a meatless ragù of dried porcini, toasted hazelnuts, vegetables and tomato, cooked in red wine with rosemary.
Biscotti a doppia cottura con i pistacch: Twice-baked biscuits with whole pistachios and white chocolate, sliced from the log while still warm.
Biscotti a doppia cottura con le mandorl: Twice-baked biscuits with almonds, sultanas and aniseed, scented with grappa and lemon.
Biscotti a filone di farina, uova, mando: Log biscuits of flour, eggs, whole almonds, lard and butter, baked twice and cut into slanted slices.
Biscotti di Natale a rombi, duri e spezi: Diamond-shaped Christmas biscuits, hard and spiced, of flour, sugar and toasted almonds with cinnamon and lemon, coated with chocolate if you like.
Biscotti di farina gialla di mais spinat: Biscuits made with yellow flour from spinato maize, the old variety of the Gandino valley: golden, crumbly, made for dunking.
Biscotti di farina, zucchero, tuorli e s: Biscuits of flour, sugar, egg yolks and lemon zest, baked until golden and crumbly.
Biscotti di frolla al burro accoppiati c: Butter shortbread biscuits sandwiched with redcurrant jam, with a hole in the top biscuit: South Tyrol's Christmas biscuits.
Biscotti di pasta di mandorle dolci e am: Biscuits of sweet and bitter almond paste bound with egg white, shaped like small bones, baked in the oven.
Biscotti di pasta frolla alla sugna, rip: Shortcrust biscuits made with lard, filled with sour cherry jam and dusted with icing sugar.
Biscotti di pasta frolla alla vaniglia u: Vanilla shortcrust biscuits sandwiched in pairs with strawberry jam and dusted with icing sugar.
Biscotti di pasta frolla allo strutto e: Shortcrust biscuits made with lard and lemon and covered with sesame seeds, the Palermo regina biscuits.
Biscotti durissimi di farina, zucchero e: Very hard biscuits of flour, sugar and water scented with cinnamon and cloves, white on top and brown underneath like bones.
Biscotti leggeri di nocciole tritate, zu: Light biscuits of chopped hazelnuts, icing sugar and whisked egg whites, scented with lemon.
Biscotti leggeri e friabili di Novara, d: Light crumbly biscuits from Novara, of semolina, flour, starch, sugar and whisked eggs, covered with sugar sprinkles.
Biscotti lievitati a goccia, fatti con u: Raised drop-shaped biscuits, made with a rope of butter dough closed into a loop and caramelised in brown sugar.
Biscotti natalizi teramani di miele, man: Christmas biscuits from the Teramo area, of honey, whole almonds and black pepper, baked in logs and sliced thin while still warm.
Biscotti salati di pane all'olio con il: Savoury bread biscuits with oil and wild fennel, baked twice until crunchy.
Bistecche di tastasale, l'impasto di mai: Tastasale patties, the pork and sausage mixture with red wine, cooked in a pan and served with borlotti beans in mustard dressing.
Bocconcini di punta di petto di bufalo i: Pieces of buffalo brisket floured and stewed in wine and stock with peas and courgettes, bound with egg yolk and lemon.
Bocconi di fegato di maiale avvolti nell: Pieces of pig's liver wrapped in caul fat with a bay leaf and cooked on the embers or in the pan.
Bocconi di maiale rosolati nello strutto: Chunks of pork browned in lard with pork fat and onions, then stewed with tomato, oregano, thyme and rosemary.
Bollito di codone di manzo, punta e test: Boiled meats of beef rump, veal brisket and calf's head cooked with vegetables, served with green sauce, mustard and Cremona mostarda.
Bombas è il nome sardo delle polpette gr: Bombas is the Sardinian name for large meatballs, coming from Catalan and Spanish, like many words of the island's cooking; Ricette Regionali gives them among the main courses.
Bottarga di Cabras e arselle degli stagn: Cabras bottarga and lagoon clams are two products of the western Sardinian coast; together they make a seafood pasta found all over the island.
Branzino intero cotto in forno su patate: Whole sea bass baked on potatoes and tomatoes with onion, pine nuts, sultanas and olives, served with sautéed spinach.
Branzino intero cotto in forno su un let: Whole sea bass baked on a bed of sliced potatoes with lemon, garlic, capers and oregano.
Broccoli appena scottati e finiti di cuo: Broccoli just blanched and finished in oil with garlic and salted anchovies, in their own juices: the first course of Cavalcanti's Neapolitan Christmas Eve.
Broccoli cotti a strati in tegame con ci: Broccoli cooked in layers in a pan with onion, anchovies, fresh pecorino and red wine, smothered until tender.
Broccoli neri stufati in padella con agl: Black broccoli stewed in the pan with garlic, oil and chilli, deglazed with white wine.
Broccoli sbollentati e gratinati con mol: Broccoli blanched and gratinated with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, chilli, cheese and raisins, with embers above and below: the Christmas Eve side dish of Fagnano Castello.
Broccoli scuri sbollentati e gratinati c: Dark broccoli, blanched and topped with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, chilli, cheese and raisins, cooked in a covered pan with embers above and below: the Christmas Eve side dish of Fagnano Castello.
Brodetto di pesce di Termoli con cicale,: Fish broth from Termoli with mantis shrimp, small langoustines, monkfish and scorpion fish cooked over chard with tomato and green pepper.
Brodo, formaggio fresco e zafferano: è l: Broth, fresh cheese and saffron: it is the festive soup of the shepherding areas, a relative of zuppa gallurese and su filindeu; Ricette Regionali gives it with tagliolini.
Brò brusà vuol dire brodo bruciato: è la: Brò brusà means burnt broth: it is the toasted-flour soup of Trentino farmers, the Tyrolean Brennsuppe, made with whatever was in the house. Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Bucatini con il cavolfiore verde stufato: Bucatini with green cauliflower stewed with anchovies, tomato, raisins and pine nuts, finished in the pan with toasted breadcrumbs.
Bucatini conditi con il sugo di stoccafi: Bucatini dressed with a sauce of stockfish cooked in peeled tomatoes with onion, garlic, chilli and parsley.
Budino al cucchiaio di acqua aromatizzat: Spoon pudding of water flavoured with cinnamon, thickened with starch and sugar and decorated with pistachios.
Budino di latte, uova e zucchero profuma: Pudding of milk, eggs and sugar scented with vanilla, cooked in a bain-marie in a caramelised mould.
Budino di mosto d'uva addensato con la f: Pudding of grape must thickened with flour, cooked until it coats the spoon and served cold.
Busiate con un ragù di tonno a dadini co: Busiate with a ragù of diced tuna cooked in tomato and white wine with mint, covered with toasted breadcrumbs with garlic and parsley.
Calamaretti e seppioline cotti in un fon: Baby squid and baby cuttlefish cooked on a base of onion, parsley, pine nuts, capers, raisins and black olives: the “cassuola” of the Neapolitan Christmas Eve.
Calamaretti saltati in padella con carot: Baby squid sautéed with carrots, peppers and celery cut into julienne and just seared, with parsley and lemon.
Calamari e piselli sono un secondo di pr: Squid and peas are a spring main course of homes in Trieste and Istria, when peas are tender.
Calamari in umido con le cipolle e l'all: Squid stewed with onions and bay leaf, slowly cooked in white wine, served on toasted bread.
Calamari piccoli cotti in tegame con le: Small squid cooked in a pan with anchovies, cherry tomatoes, onion, garlic and white wine.
Calamari ripieni dei loro tentacoli trit: Squid stuffed with their chopped tentacles, breadcrumbs, black olives, capers, garlic and parsley, baked with white wine.
Calamari ripieni di pangrattato con agli: Squid stuffed with breadcrumbs with garlic and parsley, cooked in a pan with peas and white wine.
Calzone di pasta di pane ripieno di erbe: A bread-dough calzone filled with chard dressed with oil, chilli and raisins, baked in the oven.
Calzone di pasta di pane ripieno di rico: Calzone of bread dough filled with ricotta, cooked ham, mozzarella, eggs and parmesan, fried in seed oil.
Calzone di pasta lievitata ripieno di sp: Calzone of leavened dough filled with sponsali, long Apulian spring onions, stewed with green olives and anchovies.
Camoscio marinato per un giorno nel vino: Chamois marinated for a day in red wine with herbs, then slowly cooked in butter with spices and stock.
Canederli di pane e fegato di vitello tr: Dumplings of bread and minced calf's liver with lard, onion, marjoram and lemon zest, cooked in meat broth.
Canederli di pane e formaggio schiacciat: Bread and cheese dumplings, flattened and browned in a frying pan, served in broth or with salad.
Canederli di patate e pane raffermo con: Dumplings of potato and stale bread with diced speck, cooked in water and dressed with melted butter and grana.
Canederli dolci di pasta di patate con u: Sweet potato-dough dumplings with a whole plum and a sugar cube inside, rolled in buttered breadcrumbs with sugar and cinnamon.
Canederli rosa di pane raffermo e rape r: Pink dumplings of stale bread and beetroot with a blue-cheese centre, served on cabbage with butter and cumin.
Canederli senza pane, di uova, burro, fa: Breadless dumplings of eggs, butter, flour and Trentingrana, cooked in water and served in tomato sauce with basil.
Canederli verdi di pane e spinaci con ci: Green dumplings of bread and spinach with onion, garlic and nutmeg, dressed with melted butter and parmesan.
Cannellini lessati e saltati in padella: Boiled cannellini beans sautéed in a pan with Tropea red onion, tomato and 'nduja melted in the oil.
Cannelloni all'uovo ripieni di manzo bra: Egg cannelloni filled with beef braised with vegetables and herbs, covered with béchamel and grana and baked au gratin.
Cannelloni di pasta all'uovo ripieni di: Egg-pasta cannelloni filled with roast veal, braised beef, ham and bread, baked with béchamel and parmesan.
Cannelloni di sfoglia fatta con farina d: Cannelloni of pasta sheets made with wheat and maize flour, stuffed with mixed meat with pecorino and nutmeg, browned in the oven with butter.
Cannelloni ripieni di ricotta, parmigian: Cannelloni filled with ricotta, parmesan, eggs and parsley, baked in tomato sauce.
Cannelloni ripieni di vitello macinato c: Cannelloni filled with minced veal with eggs, parmesan, breadcrumbs and a pinch of aniseed, baked in tomato sauce.
Cannoli di pasta lievitata allo strutto: Rolled tubes of leavened lard dough, fried and rolled in sugar, filled with sheep's ricotta cream with chocolate.
Capesante nella loro conchiglia, condite: Scallops in their shells, dressed with oil, garlic, parsley and dill and put in a hot oven for a few minutes.
Capitone a tranci rosolato con le cipoll: Eel in steaks browned with onions, deglazed with white wine and cooked in San Marzano tomatoes with basil.
Capo Vaticano, il promontorio vicino a T: Capo Vaticano, the headland near Tropea, is surrounded by red onion fields: the soup is the Calabrian version of the French one.

Capo Vaticano, the headland near Tropea, is surrounded by red onion fields: the soup is the Calabrian version of the French one. Ingredients and quantities are those of the Ricette Regionali page; the method is rewritten here, in more detail.
Capocollo di maiale intero marinato e br: Whole pork capocollo marinated and slowly braised in red wine with juniper, cloves and bay leaf.
Cappelle di champignon ripiene di mollic: Button mushroom caps stuffed with breadcrumb, chopped stems, garlic, parsley and cheese, baked au gratin.
Cappelle di porcini spennellate di olio: Porcini caps brushed with oil and garlic and cooked on the grill, served with salt and pepper.
Cappelletti di pasta all'uovo ripieni di: Egg-pasta cappelletti filled with veal, pork, chicken, sausage, prosciutto and mortadella, cooked in capon broth.
Cappelletti di sfoglia all'uovo ripieni: Egg-pasta cappelletti filled with pork loin and capon breast browned in herb butter, with ricotta and parmesan, in capon broth.
Egg-pasta cappelletti filled with cooked and minced pork loin and chicken breast, mortadella, stracchino and Parmigiano, cooked in capon broth.
Egg-pasta cappelletti filled with veal, beef, pork and sausage cooked in wine, with parmesan, served in broth.
Cappelli di ovoli conditi con olio, agli: Caesar's mushroom caps dressed with oil, garlic and oregano and baked sealed in paper.
Cappone disossato farcito di vitello, li: Boned capon stuffed with veal, salted tongue, pork belly, pistachios and truffle, cooked in broth and served cold in aspic.
Cappone intero chiuso nella vescica di m: Whole capon sealed in a pig's bladder with vegetables and simmered for a long time, so that it stays juicy and cooks in its own juices.
Capretto a pezzi arrostito in forno con: Kid in pieces roasted in the oven with lard, rosemary, onion and potatoes.
Capretto a pezzi cotto in forno nel burr: Kid in pieces roasted in butter and lard with sage and new potatoes, with chopped walnuts at the end.
Capretto a pezzi rosolato nel lardo con: Kid in pieces browned in lard with onion and garlic, cooked in dry wine with a little tomato and parsley.
Capretto marinato nell'aceto con ginepro: Kid marinated in vinegar with juniper and herbs, cooked in a pan in butter and oil with rosemary, sage and bay.
Capriolo marinato nel vino rosso valdost: Roe deer marinated in Aosta Valley red wine with spices, cooked with tomato and bound with a little cream.
Carciofi a spicchi cotti in tegame coper: Artichoke wedges cooked in a covered pan with garlic, chilli, Gaeta olives, capers and a little water, finished with parsley.
Carciofi a spicchi stufati nell'olio e n: Artichoke wedges stewed in oil and butter and then set with beaten eggs, milk and parmesan.
Carciofi aperti e riempiti di pangrattat: Artichokes opened and filled with breadcrumbs with garlic and parsley, cooked in a pan with oil and a little water.
Carciofi crudi tagliati sottilissimi, co: Raw artichokes sliced very thinly, dressed with lemon and oil and covered with grated grey mullet bottarga.
Carciofi riempiti di uova, formaggio, ag: Artichokes filled with eggs, cheese, garlic and parsley and cooked in a pan with fresh broad beans and a drizzle of oil.
Carciofi ripieni di pangrattato con le a: Artichokes stuffed with breadcrumbs with chopped anchovies, garlic and parsley, cooked in a pan with oil.
Carciofi sardi a spicchi stufati con le: Sardinian artichokes in wedges stewed with fresh white onions, lemon and parsley, until tender and sweet.
Carciofi violetti aperti e riempiti di p: Purple artichokes opened and filled with breadcrumbs, pecorino, caciocavallo, garlic and parsley, cooked in a pan with oil and a little water.
Carciofini mondati, lessati nel vino bia: Trimmed baby artichokes, boiled in white wine and vinegar with spices, dried and preserved under oil.
Cardi lessati e poi cotti nel brodo di c: Cardoons boiled and then cooked in meat broth, bound at the end with beaten eggs and grana: the first course of winter feast days.
Cardi lessati e poi cotti nel latte con: Cardoons boiled and then cooked in milk with butter and flour, finished with parmesan.
Cardi lessati e ripassati nel burro, poi: Cardoons boiled and tossed in butter, then sprinkled with parmesan and baked.
Cardi lessati nell'acqua acidulata, pass: Cardoons boiled in acidulated water, dipped in flour and egg and fried in oil with garlic.
Cardi lessati, passati nell'uovo e fritt: Cardoons boiled, dipped in egg and fried, then baked in layers with a beef shank ragù, parmigiano and scamorza.
Carne di capra marinata una notte nel vi: Goat meat marinated overnight in red wine with bay, sage and rosemary, then slowly stewed with onion and tomato.
Carne di cinghiale marinata nel vino ros: Wild boar meat marinated in red wine with vegetables, bay and cloves, then cooked in the same marinade.
Carne di pecora a pezzi cotta a lungo co: Mutton in pieces cooked slowly with tomatoes, onion, rosemary and chilli, served over country bread.
Carni miste e lucanica cotte a lungo con: Mixed meats and lucanica sausage cooked slowly with lard and onion in white wine and broth, with a touch of flour and tomato extract.
Carote cotte intere sotto la cenere cald: Carrots cooked whole under hot ash (or in the oven), sliced and dressed with salt, pepper and lemon juice: a very simple side dish of 18th-century Naples.
Carote novelle stufate nell'olio e sfuma: Baby carrots stewed in oil and deglazed with dry Marsala until the wine becomes a glaze.
Casarecce con un sugo di pesce spada a d: Casarecce with a sauce of diced swordfish, fried eggplant, tomato and mint, deglazed with white wine.
Casarecce di farina di ceci su una crema: Chickpea-flour casarecce on a herbed carrot cream, with broccoli sautéed with garlic and chilli.
Casce e ova, cacio e uova, è il piatto p: Casce e ova, cheese and eggs, is the most famous dish of Molise and Abruzzo peasant cooking: meatless balls for farmers' feasts. Ricette Regionali gives them among the starters.
Casoncelli di sfoglia all'uovo ripieni d: Egg-pasta casoncelli filled with chard, potatoes, leek and sausage, dressed with melted butter and grana.
Castagnaccio della tradizione bresciana:: Chestnut cake in the Brescia tradition: chestnut flour, raisins and pine nuts, baked thin in a moderate oven.
Castagne e riso si incontrano nelle mine: Chestnuts and rice meet in the soups of the whole western Alpine arc; in the Aosta Valley the fontina in the bowl turns it into a whole meal. Ricette Regionali gives it among the first courses.
Castagne incise e cotte nel vino rosso c: Scored chestnuts cooked in red wine with bay leaves, until the wine reduces to a syrup.
Castagne lessate con l'alloro e passate: Chestnuts boiled with bay leaf and puréed with sugar, vanillin and rum, served with sultanas and pine nuts.
Castagne, miele e lardo sono il cibo del: Chestnuts, honey and lard are the autumn food of the lower valley, from Arnad to Donnas, where the chestnut woods climb up to the vineyards; Ricette Regionali puts them together in this starter.
Castagnole di Agnone, palline di pasta a: Castagnole from Agnone, balls of egg dough fried and then glazed with cooked sugar and chocolate.
Cavatelli con le lenticchie cotte in un: Cavatelli with lentils cooked in a tomato sauce with vegetables, herbs, cloves and diced ham.
Cavatelli cotti con i ceci lessati in un: Cavatelli cooked with boiled chickpeas in a sauce of cherry tomatoes, onion, garlic, bay leaf and chilli.
Cavatelli cotti con la rucola e conditi: Cavatelli cooked with rocket and dressed with a sauce of fresh tomatoes, spring onions, celery and anchovies, finished with pecorino.
Cavatelli di semola cotti con i broccoli: Semolina cavatelli cooked with turnip tops and dressed with oil, garlic and chilli.
Cavatelli di semola fatti a mano con un: Hand-made semolina cavatelli with a sauce of red and yellow peppers, Tropea onion and spicy sausage.
Cavatelli di semola fatti a mano conditi: Handmade semolina cavatelli dressed with a sauce of mushrooms and fresh puréed tomatoes, garlic and parsley.
Cavatelli di semola fatti a mano, condit: Handmade semolina cavatelli, dressed with turnip tops tossed in a pan with garlic, oil and chilli.
Cavatelli fatti a mano conditi con pance: Handmade cavatelli dressed with browned pancetta and beaten eggs that set on the hot pasta.
Cavatelli scuri di grano arso con i fagi: Dark burnt-wheat cavatelli with boiled beans, hanging winter tomatoes and garlic, dressed with raw oil.
Cavolfiore a cimette stufato nel pomodor: Cauliflower florets stewed in tomato with onion and chilli, finished with grated cheese.
Cavolfiore lessato e schiacciato con l'o: Cauliflower boiled and crushed with oil and garlic, spread on toasted saltless bread.
Cavoli e fagioli dell'orto, lardo della: Cabbage and beans from the garden, lard from the pantry and polenta: it is the farmers' winter supper of the lower valley. Ricette Regionali gives it among the main courses.
Cavolo a strisce stufato con il lardo af: Cabbage in strips stewed with smoked lard, onion, garlic and bay, moistened with white wine.
Cavolo cappuccio crudo a fili condito co: Raw white cabbage in thin shreds dressed with warm oil and vinegar, caraway and browned speck.
Cavolo cappuccio e cicorie lessati e cot: White cabbage and chicory boiled and cooked in stock with pig's trotter and pork rind, scented with fennel seeds.
Cavolo da insalata a striscioline sottil: Salad cabbage in thin strips dressed with oil, vinegar and garlic, left to soften.
Cavolo rosso e speck sono i sapori dell': Red cabbage and speck are the flavours of the Tyrolean winter; this savoury tart with puff pastry is a modern recipe, which Ricette Regionali gives this way.
Cavolo rosso stufato nel burro con lo sp: Red cabbage stewed in butter with speck, onion and apple and slowly cooked in red wine.
Ceci cotti a lungo con pomodoro, cipolla: Chickpeas cooked slowly with tomato, onion, bay and chilli and coloured yellow by saffron.
Ceci di terra e arselle di laguna: è una: Chickpeas from the land and clams from the lagoon: it is a soup of the Cagliari area, where the lagoons are close to the gardens; camona, or camone, tomatoes are the green, crunchy kind from the greenhouses of the south of the island. Ricette Regionali gives it among the first courses.
Ceci e alici è un abbinamento romano di: Chickpeas and anchovies are a Roman meatless pairing: the soup was eaten on Fridays and in Lent.

Chickpeas and anchovies are a Roman meatless pairing: the soup was eaten on Fridays and in Lent. Ingredients and quantities are those of the Ricette Regionali page; the method is rewritten here, in more detail.
Ceci e castagne cotti a lungo con aglio,: Chickpeas and chestnuts slowly cooked with garlic, rosemary, bay leaf and a little tomato: the mountain soup of autumn.
Ceci lessati con il rosmarino in una min: Chickpeas boiled with rosemary in a soup flavoured with anchovies, garlic, chilli and tomatoes, served on toasted bread.
Cefali lessati in acqua molto salata e c: Grey mullet boiled in very salty water and kept wrapped in marsh grass, zibba: an ancient dish of the Cabras lagoons.
Cerluzzi è il nome dei piccoli merluzzi: Cerluzzi is the name of small hake in the dialect of the Molise coast; Ricette Regionali gives them alla marinara, simple.
Cespi di indivia belga ripieni di gorgon: Heads of chicory (Belgian endive) filled with gorgonzola and walnuts and browned in the oven: a popular, full-flavoured Lombard starter.
Cespi di lattuga lessati e conditi con u: Heads of lettuce boiled and dressed with a sauce of tarragon pounded with anchovies and capers, loosened with oil and vinegar: Corrado's way to “render la lattuga gustosa” (make lettuce tasty).
Cespi di radicchio tagliati in quarti, c: Heads of radicchio cut into quarters, cooked on the grill and dressed with oil, salt and pepper.
Cestini di pasta all'olio ripieni di ric: Little baskets of oil pastry filled with sheep's ricotta whipped with eggs, sugar and lemon, which puffs up in the oven like a soufflé.
Cestini di pasta sfoglia ripieni di fega: Puff pastry cases filled with chicken livers and dried mushrooms cooked in white wine, with a shaving of truffle.
Chicchi di grano tenuti a bagno una nott: Wheat berries soaked overnight and boiled, then dressed with a thick ragù of minced lamb and pork, chilli and ricotta salata.
Chiocciole cotte nel vino rosso e nel br: Snails cooked in red wine and broth with onion and potato, put back in their shells and baked with breadcrumbs and parsley.
Cialde all'anice cotte nel ferro rovente: Aniseed wafers cooked in a red-hot iron, thin and crisp, with the grid pattern that gives them their name.
Cialde sottilissime di mandorle, nocciol: Very thin wafers of almonds, hazelnuts and egg whites, curved like roof tiles while still warm: the biscuits of Aosta.
Ciambella di pasta frolla morbida al bur: Soft butter and grappa cake shaped like an S or a ring, baked and meant for dunking.
Ciambelle di pasta lievitata al limone f: Rings of lemon-scented yeast dough fried and rolled in sugar, the snack of Tuscan beaches.
Ciambelline abruzzesi all'anice, impasta: Abruzzo aniseed rings, made with eggs, milk and oil, raised with baker's ammonia and baked until golden and crumbly.
Ciambelline all'anice cotte in forno e g: Aniseed ring biscuits baked and glazed in cooked sugar until they turn white: the wedding sweets of the mountains.
Ciambelline croccanti di farina, zuccher: Crisp little rings of flour, sugar, white wine and oil scented with aniseed.
Ciambelline di pasta all'uovo e olio pro: Little rings of egg and oil dough scented with Strega liqueur and lemon, baked and glazed with sugar.
Ciambelline friabili di frolla al burro: Crumbly little rings of butter shortcrust with cornflour and lemon zest, baked in the oven.
Ciambotta di pesce di Termoli: moscardin: Fish ciambotta from Termoli: baby octopus, red mullet and saddled bream cooked with tomatoes, onion and green pepper, over toasted bread.
Ciciulena è il nome siciliano del sesamo: Ciciulena is the Sicilian name for sesame, brought by the Arabs; biscuits covered in sesame, also called regina biscuits, are found in every bakery in Palermo. Ricette Regionali gives them this way.
Cimette di cavolfiore lessate e gratinat: Cauliflower florets boiled and baked under béchamel with nutmeg and parmesan.
Cimette di cavolfiore lessate e passate: Cauliflower florets boiled and dipped in a batter of eggs, flour and pecorino, fried until crisp.
Cimette di cavolfiore lessate, passate i: Cauliflower florets boiled, dipped in a batter of eggs, flour and white wine and fried in oil.
Cinghiale marinato e brasato a lungo nel: Wild boar marinated and braised for a long time in Barolo with onions, celery, pepper, garlic, herbs and spices.
Cinghiale marinato nel vino rosso con le: Wild boar marinated in red wine with vegetables and spices, cooked with porcini and served with a blueberry and redcurrant sauce.
Cinghiale marinato una notte nel Cannona: Wild boar marinated overnight in Cannonau with vegetables and cooked slowly in the same wine with sun-dried tomatoes and fennel olives.
Cioccolatini di Cuneo: due meringhe al c: Cuneo chocolates: two cocoa meringues joined with a rum cream and coated in dark chocolate.
Cipolle a fette fritte lentamente nel la: Sliced onions slowly fried in lard until sweet and golden.
Cipolle bianche lessate, svuotate e riem: White onions boiled, hollowed out and filled with potato, mortadella, parmesan, eggs and marjoram, then baked au gratin.
Cipolle rosse di Acquaviva a spicchi cot: Red Acquaviva onions in wedges cooked slowly with oil, brown sugar and vinegar into a glossy jam.
Cipolle stufate a lungo nell'olio finché: Onions stewed slowly in oil until sweet, bound into an omelette with eggs and parmesan.

Pane toscano a fette farcito con la fino: Sliced Tuscan bread filled with finocchiona, the wild-fennel salami, and aged pecorino.
Panini dolci di pasta brioche allo strut: Sweet lard brioche buns filled with meat ragù and peas, brushed with egg and covered with sesame, baked in the oven.
Panini dolci e salati di pasta lievitata: Sweet-and-savoury rolls of a leavened dough made with lard, eggs and a little sugar, packed with diced cured ham: the Neapolitan recipe of Cavalcanti, 1847.
Panini morbidi allo strutto arrotolati c: Soft lard rolls rolled up with mortadella, Neapolitan salami, sharp provolone, hard-boiled eggs, pecorino and pepper.
Panini morbidi di semola e farina impast: Soft rolls of semolina and flour kneaded with sheep's ricotta, which keeps the crumb moist for days.
Panino caldo con straccetti di manzo, sc: Hot sandwich with strips of beef, smoked scamorza, grilled aubergines, lettuce and caciocavallo.
Panino lungo di pasta da pizza fritta, a: Long roll of fried pizza dough, split and filled with cherry tomatoes, buffalo ricotta, smoked provola and a touch of pesto.
Panna montata e mascarpone zuccherato in: Whipped cream and sweetened mascarpone in a glass, to be 'drowned' at the table with a hot espresso: a spoon tiramisù without biscuits and without eggs.
Panna, brandy e funghi sono il condiment: Cream, brandy and mushrooms are the restaurant sauce of the eighties, all over Italy; Ricette Regionali gives these tagliatelle among the Trentino recipes, for the porcini of the valleys.
Pannocchie è il nome delle canocchie sul: Pannocchie is the name of mantis shrimp on the Molise and Abruzzo coast: they are caught in winter and eaten like this, all'agro. Ricette Regionali gives them among the main courses.
Pannocchie, le canocchie dell'Adriatico,: Pannocchie, the Adriatic mantis shrimp, boiled and dressed with oil, lemon, garlic and parsley.
Pantelleria, l'isola tra la Sicilia e l': Pantelleria, the island between Sicily and Africa, is famous for capers grown among the dry-stone walls; its salad puts them together with potatoes. Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Pappa densa di farina e latte cotta nel: A thick porridge of flour and milk cooked in butter, served hot with melted butter and sugar or with lingonberries: the breakfast of South Tyrolean farmers.
Pappardelle all'uovo con un ragù bianco: Egg pappardelle with a white ragù of wild boar marinated in red wine with spices, cooked with mushrooms and milk.
Egg pappardelle with a white ragù of hand-chopped Cinta Senese pork shoulder, cooked in white wine with juniper and bay leaf.
Pappardelle fatte in casa con il sugo d': Homemade pappardelle with a sauce of duck cooked in pieces with its liver and gizzard, aromatics, white wine and tomato.
Passatelli di pangrattato, formaggio, uo: Passatelli of breadcrumbs, cheese, eggs and lemon dressed with a sauce of clams, cuttlefish and prawns: Pesaro's first De.Co. dish.
Pasta all'uovo tagliata a rombi irregola: Egg pasta cut into irregular diamonds and dressed with a sauce of minced meat, sausage and tomato, with parmesan.
Pasta corta in un sugo cremoso di zucca: Short pasta in a creamy sauce of diced pumpkin cooked with crumbled sausage, fennel, rosemary and chilli, finished with Parmesan.
Pasta corta in una crema di gorgonzola s: Short pasta in a cream of gorgonzola melted in single cream, scented with a drop of grappa and parmesan.
Pasta corta rigata condita con guanciale: Short ridged pasta dressed with browned guanciale and a saffron ricotta cream, the dish of the red gold of the Navelli plain.
Pasta cotta nella crema di fave secche b: Pasta cooked in a cream of white dried broad beans, dressed only with raw oil, salt and pepper.
Pasta cotta sul fuoco con burro, zuccher: A dough cooked on the heat with butter, sugar and citron, beaten with eggs, with candied citron blossom and amaretti, baked by the spoonful: little Neapolitan choux buns.
Pasta da strudel tirata sottilissima e a: Strudel dough stretched paper-thin and rolled around stoned cherries, sugar, cinnamon and breadcrumbs toasted in butter.
Pasta di pane lievitata, fritta in olio: Risen bread dough, fried in hot oil and tossed in sugar or salt: a home tradition in Gangi.
Pasta di semola con le cozze aperte in p: Semolina pasta with mussels opened in a pan, cherry tomatoes, garlic, chilli and rocket.
Pasta di sola acqua e farina, a quadrett: Pasta of just flour and water, cut into squares or thin noodles, cooked in a frugal broth of water, lard and vegetables: the farmhouse soup of Filottrano.
Pasta di sola farina e acqua arrotolata: Pasta made only from flour and water and rolled by hand, dressed with the «fake» vegetable sauce, with no meat: the dish of the festival at Sticciano Scalo, in the municipality of Roccastrada.
Pasta e ceci è il primo di tutti i giorn: Pasta with chickpeas is the everyday first course of Apulian peasant cooking; with cavatelli it is made above all around Bari.

Pasta lunga condita a crudo con le noci: Long pasta dressed raw with pounded walnuts, salty pecorino, basil and oil.
Pasta mista cotta con le fave fresche st: Mixed pasta cooked with fresh broad beans stewed with smoked pancetta and spring onions, finished with parmesan.
Pasta, melanzana fritta, pomodoro e form: Pasta, fried aubergine, tomato and cheese are the same as in pasta alla Norma; here they are closed into rolls, a recent presentation that Ricette Regionali gives among the Sicilian first courses.
Pastella al rum e limone con le erbe aro: Rum and lemon batter with garden herbs, mint, lemon balm, chamomile and fennel seeds, fried by spoonfuls and rolled in sugar.
Pastella morbida di farina, acqua tiepid: A soft batter of flour, lukewarm water and yeast with blanched salt cod, fried by the spoonful in oil: the zeppolelle of Holy Tuesday “tutto d'olio” (all with oil).
Pasticcini morbidi di mandorle, zucchero: Soft pastries of almonds, sugar and egg white, pinched with the fingers and scented with lemon, the Sicilian almond pastries.
Pasticcio al forno di lasagne, finocchi: Baked pie of lasagne sheets, fennel stewed with garlic and chilli, béchamel, parmesan and Emmental.
Pastiera di frolla al cacao ripiena di g: Pastiera with a cocoa shortcrust filled with wheat cooked in milk with dark chocolate, cow's and sheep's ricotta, candied peel and orange flower water.
Patate a fette cotte al forno a strati c: Sliced potatoes baked in layers with Gruyère and butter, moistened with milk, until browned.
Patate e fagioli del pastore cotti a lun: Potatoes and shepherd's beans cooked slowly and mashed together, dressed with browned pork belly, chilli and oil.
Patate e foglie di cavolo cappuccio less: Potatoes and white cabbage leaves boiled together and sautéed in a pan with onion and pancetta, lightly crushing them.
Patate lessate e ripassate in tegame con: Boiled potatoes finished in a pan with onion, capers and green olives, sweet-and-sour with vinegar and sugar.
Patate lesse e fettine di vitello rosola: Boiled potatoes and veal slices browned together in butter with onion, bay and marjoram, until they form a crust.
Paté morbido di petto e fegato d'anatra: Smooth pâté of duck breast and liver cooked in milk with herbs, deglazed with marsala and cognac and blended with butter and cream.
Pelle del collo d'oca riempita di carne: Goose neck skin filled with goose meat, bread, egg and parsley, sewn up and slowly cooked in tomato, with polenta.
Penne al forno con zucchine e pancetta a: Baked penne with courgettes and smoked pancetta, mozzarella, scamorza and grana, au gratin.
Penne con la luganega sbriciolata, cotta: Penne with crumbled luganega sausage, cooked in cream with saffron and finished with parmesan and parsley.
Penne con le patate, la rucola e la sals: Penne with potatoes, rocket and tomato sauce: white, green and red like the flag.
Penne con un ragù di salsiccia cotto nel: Penne with a sausage ragù cooked in red wine and tomato, scented with clove, nutmeg and cinnamon, with piacentino cheese.
Penne lisce mantecate in una salsa di po: Smooth penne finished in a tomato sauce with plenty of cold butter, aged parmesan and basil.
Pennette con un sugo di porcini, pancett: Pennette with a sauce of porcini, smoked pancetta and tomato, finished with a little cream and parsley.
Pennette in una crema di formaggio Salva: Pennette in a cream of Salva cheese melted in single cream, with chopped walnuts and pistachios toasted in butter.
Peperoncini tondi scottati nell'aceto e: Round cherry peppers blanched in vinegar and filled with tuna and capers, preserved in oil for the winter starter.
Peperoni arrostiti a falde, conditi con: Roasted peppers in strips, dressed with toasted breadcrumbs, garlic, capers and a drizzle of vinegar.
Peperoni e capperi sono due prodotti del: Peppers and capers are two products of the Sicilian islands, from Salina to Pantelleria; Ricette Regionali combines them in this side dish.
Peperoni e pomodori cotti in padella con: Peppers and tomatoes cooked in a pan with onion, basil and chilli, then bound with beaten eggs: the summer one-dish meal of the Molise countryside.
Peperoni ripieni di pangrattato, acciugh: Peppers stuffed with breadcrumbs, anchovies, tomato sauce, herbs and chilli, baked with oil.
Peperoni rossi e gialli saltati in padel: Red and yellow peppers sautéed with garlic and capers and finished with toasted breadcrumbs and basil.
Peperoni verdi, pomodori e cipolle stufa: Green peppers, tomatoes and onions stewed together: green, red and white, like the flag.
Peperoni, cipolle, zucchine e sedano stu: Peppers, onions, courgettes and celery stewed in butter with tomato pulp and a dash of vinegar.

Per la besciamella, se non è già pronta:: For the béchamel, if it is not ready-made: melt 50 g of butter, stir in 50 g of flour, then pour in 600 ml of hot milk in a thin stream and cook, stirring, for 8-10 minutes, with salt and nutmeg.
Per la spuma: portare a bollore in un pe: For the foam: bring the grapefruit juice to the boil in a small pan with the agar-agar and simmer for 4 minutes; leave it to cool until set, then whisk it with an electric whisk to a frothy sauce.
Pesce spada e melanzane sono l'incontro: Swordfish and eggplant are the meeting of sea and garden in eastern Sicily, from Messina to Syracuse; Ricette Regionali combines them on casarecce, the island's rolled short pasta.
Pesce spada, melanzana e menta sono il s: Swordfish, aubergine and mint are the taste of summer in Messina and on the Strait; this version with brandy and Tropea onion is a recent chef's recipe, which GialloZafferano gives this way.
Pesci di lago piccoli cotti sulla brace: Small lake fish cooked on live embers with their scales, then cleaned and dressed with oil, lemon, parsley, salt and pepper.
Pesto e pesce sono un accostamento moder: Pesto and seafood are a modern Riviera pairing: Genoese basil PDO, with its small tender leaves, goes well with the prawns of the gulf.
Petti di pollo infarinati e dorati nel b: Chicken breasts floured and browned in butter, deglazed with white wine and covered with fontina that melts in the pan.
Petti di pollo infarinati e rosolati, co: Chicken breasts floured and browned, topped with cooked ham and fontina and cooked with wine until the cheese melts.
Petto d'anatra infarinato e rosolato, br: Duck breast floured and browned, braised slowly in a bottle of Barolo with vegetables and herbs.
Petto d'anatra rosolato con timo e aglio: Duck breast seared with thyme and garlic and glazed with Lagrein, served with a walnut risotto.
Petto di cappone lessato e sfilacciato,: Boiled capon breast in shreds, with rum-soaked raisins, green salad, vegetables and a vinegar dressing, served with pear mostarda.
Petto di castrato cotto lentamente nel s: Breast of mutton cooked slowly in tomato sauce and finished with the local green beans: the dish that rounds off a Geraci lunch.
Pezza cun limoni, carne con il limone in: Pezza cun limoni, meat with lemon in Sardinian, is a quick main course of the island's homes, where lemons grow in the gardens; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Pezzi di anatra rosolati nel burro e cot: Duck pieces browned in butter and cooked in wine with juniper and herbs, then glazed with a honey and lemon caramel.
Pezzi di pollo arrosto in una salsa di t: Pieces of roast chicken in a sauce of hard-boiled yolks, mustard and vinegar with fresh herbs, anchovies and prawn tails, covered with mayonnaise: a Neapolitan salad of the nineteenth century.
Pezzi di polpa di maiale rosolati a lung: Pieces of pork browned slowly with onions in their own fat, until golden and tender.
Pezzo di manzo lardellato con le acciugh: Joint of beef larded with salted anchovies, browned and slowly cooked in white wine with lemon and nutmeg.
Piantine giovani di cicorino con la radi: Young chicory plants with their root, dressed with oil and vinegar and chopped hard-boiled eggs.
Piccioni arrostiti in tegame con l'aglio: Pigeons pan-roasted with garlic, sage and rosemary, deglazed with white wine and finished with black olives.
Piccole focaccine di farina di castagne,: Small flatbreads of chestnut flour, milk and oil, cooked on a griddle or in the oven.
Piccole frittate di uova e pecorino con: Small omelettes of eggs and pecorino with grated grey mullet bottarga, cooked in the pan like fritters.
Piccole lumache di terra lessate e condi: Small land snails boiled and dressed while hot with oil, garlic, parsley and lemon, to be eaten with a toothpick.
Piccole melanzane tonde incise e farcite: Small round eggplants slit and stuffed with garlic, mint and caciocavallo, browned and cooked in tomato pulp.
Piccole panadas di pasta di semola e str: Small panadas of semolina and lard pastry, closed into little baskets with a pinched edge and filled with stewed spiny artichokes.
Piccoli cestini di pasta frolla allo str: Small shortcrust baskets made with lard and filled with sweetened ricotta with candied citron, chocolate, orange and cinnamon.
Piccoli dolci di pasta frolla al burro e: Small shortcrust pastries made with butter and yolks, baked in moulds and filled with cherry jam, dusted with icing sugar.
Piccoli dolci di pasta frolla ripieni di: Small shortcrust pastries filled with a cream of ricotta, sugar, cinnamon and lemon, baked in the oven.
Piccoli pesci del lago di Garda passati: Small fish from Lake Garda dipped in milk and flour and fried crisp, to be eaten whole.
Pici con un sugo di spalla senese a list: Pici with a sauce of Siena cured shoulder in strips, shallot and tomato pulp deglazed with Vernaccia, finished with pecorino and thyme.
Pici fatti a mano conditi con un pesto c: Handmade pici dressed with a raw pesto of garlic, parsley, mint, basil, hard-boiled egg, sharp pecorino and oil.
Pici tirati a mano conditi con le bricio: Hand-rolled pici dressed with crumbs of saltless bread toasted in oil with garlic and chilli.
Pinoli e uvetta con il pesce vengono dal: Pine nuts and sultanas with fish come from Venetian and Dalmatian cooking, which reached Trieste and Grado through the Republic of Venice's trade.
Pinoli pestati nel mortaio con la mollic: Pine nuts pounded in the mortar with bread crumb and vinegar and bound with oil: the sauce for boiled fish and vegetables.
Piselli freschi lessati e conditi con un: Fresh peas boiled and dressed with a paste of anchovies and pine nuts loosened with oil and lemon juice, with pepper: a meatless side dish by Corrado.

Polenta cotta nel latte e nell'acqua, al: Polenta cooked in milk and water, layered with fontina and butter and baked until golden.
Polenta di farina di grano cotta a lungo: Polenta of wheat flour cooked slowly and dressed with sausage and sautéed porcini, butter and cheese.
Polenta di grano di Colli a Volturno con: Wheat polenta from Colli a Volturno dressed with turnip tops sautéed with pork belly, garlic, chilli and pecorino.

Polenta morbida con la cicoria di campo: Soft polenta with wild chicory sautéed in a frying pan with sausage, garlic and chilli: the breakfast of the pig-killing feast.
Polenta morbida con una minestra densa d: Soft polenta with a thick soup of black kale and beans cooked slowly with lard.
Polenta morbida cotta con le foglie di c: Soft polenta cooked with cabbage leaves and dressed with pork scratchings, melted lard and butter.
Polenta morbida di farina di marroni ess: Soft polenta of dried marroni chestnut flour, naturally sweet, eaten hot or cold in slices: the frugal sweet of the Castel del Rio chestnut woods.
Polenta morbida di grano saraceno cotta: Soft buckwheat polenta cooked in water and milk, with casera cheese and onion fried in lard.
Polenta morbida di mais e grano saraceno: Soft polenta of maize and buckwheat served with robiola and shaved white truffle.

Polenta morbida servita con un sugo di s: Soft polenta served with a sauce of langoustines, mantis shrimps, clams and baby octopus cooked in white wine with cherry tomatoes.
Polenta morbida versata sulla spianatoia: Soft polenta poured onto the wooden board and covered with a sauce of sausages, pancetta, tomato and chilli, to be eaten all together.
Polenta tagliata sul tagliere e mescolat: Polenta cut on the board and mixed in the plate with wild greens boiled and then sautéed slowly with garlic and oil.
Polenta, fagioli e maiale sono il pranzo: Polenta, beans and pork are the winter lunch of Trentino farming families; the sweet spices come from trade with Venice. Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Polentina di farina di segale cotta nel: Soft rye polenta cooked in broth, poured in layers with black bread, fontina and onions browned in butter.
Polentina di mais cotta insieme a fagiol: Soft maize polenta cooked together with beans and savoy cabbage: one of the oldest dishes of Busto Arsizio's cooking, which still carries the Romans' “puls” in its name.
Pollo a pezzi cotto lentamente in tegame: Chicken in pieces cooked slowly in a pan with lots of onions that melt into a glossy golden sauce, finished with lemon.

Pollo a pezzi lessato, poi infarinato, p: Chicken in pieces boiled, then floured, dipped in egg and in breadcrumbs with Montasio and parsley and fried.

Pollo in umido al vino rosso con il pomo: Chicken stewed in red wine with tomato and herbs, served with rocchini, pieces of celery fried in a coating of egg and parmesan.
Polpa di capriolo marinata nel vino ross: Roe deer marinated in red wine with vegetables and spices, cooked with pancetta and served with a blueberry and cream sauce.
Polpa di cavedano lessata, spinata con c: Poached chub, carefully boned and whipped with butter, served cold in aspic: an old starter from Lake Como and the Brescia shore of Lake Garda.
Polpa di maiale a pezzi stufata con molt: Pork in pieces stewed with plenty of onions and green apples, which melt into a sweet and tangy sauce.
Polpette di cacio e uova con la mollica: Cheese and egg balls with breadcrumb, fried and then cooked in a tomato and pepper sauce: the meat of the poor.
Polpette di carne avanzata avvolte nelle: Meatballs of leftover meat wrapped in savoy cabbage leaves and cooked gently in butter and broth: Busto Arsizio cooking that teaches you not to waste.
Polpette di carne e fegato di maiale con: Patties of pork meat and liver with sausage, parmesan and spices, wrapped in caul fat and cooked in a pan with gin.

Polpette di ricotta di pecora, mollica,: Balls of sheep's ricotta, breadcrumb, pecorino and parmesan, cooked in tomato and basil sauce without frying.
Polpette di spalla d'agnello tritata con: Meatballs of minced lamb shoulder with breadcrumb, mint, onion and garlic, breaded and fried in oil.
Polpette di vitello, maiale e salsiccia: Meatballs of veal, pork and sausage cooked in butter with shallot and wine, served with pan-fried potatoes and artichokes.
Polpette schiacciate di ceci, fagioli ro: Flattened patties of chickpeas, red beans and lentils with vegetables and pistachios, coated in panko and baked, with a spinach and orange salad.
Polpetti piccoli cotti adagio nel vino b: Small octopuses cooked slowly in white wine with carrot, celery and herbs, until tender.
Polpettine di carne magra, prosciutto co: Little meatballs of lean meat, ham, breadcrumb and parmesan cooked in meat broth.
Polpettine di ricotta di pecora, pangrat: Little dumplings of sheep's ricotta, breadcrumbs, eggs and parsley cooked in meat stock and served in the stock.
Polpettone di vitello e grana lessato co: Veal and grana meatloaf boiled with vegetables, served in slices with a green sauce of parsley, capers and anchovies.
Polpi essiccati al sole, ammollati e cot: Sun-dried octopus, soaked and cooked in tomato with onion and parsley.
Polpi lessati e poi arrostiti allo spied: Octopus boiled and then roasted on the spit or the grill, dressed with oil, garlic, parsley and lemon.

Pomodori svuotati e riempiti di mollica: Tomatoes hollowed out and filled with bread crumb, spring onions, eggs and basil, baked with oil.

Pomodorini pennuli saltati a fuoco vivo: Pennula cherry tomatoes tossed over high heat in oil until the skins burst, with capers and basil.

Porcini freschi cotti con aglio, prezzem: Fresh porcini cooked with garlic, parsley and a little tomato, in a soup with fregola.
Porri e patate cotti a lungo nel brodo d: Leeks and potatoes cooked slowly in meat broth, with short pasta and parmesan: the everyday winter soup.

Primo tipico di Castel del Rio fatto con: A typical first course of Castel del Rio made with the purée of the Santerno valley's marroni chestnuts, here wrapped in egg-pasta tortelli and dressed with butter and sage.
Prosciutto di Parma, parmigiano e aceto: Parma ham, parmesan and balsamic vinegar of Modena are the three best-known products of Emilia; this modern GialloZafferano starter brings them together.
Pulire i carciofi sardi togliendo le fog: Clean the Sardinian artichokes removing the tough leaves and the choke, cut them into wedges and put them in water with the juice of the small lemon.
Purè rustico di fagioli, zucca e patate: Rustic mash of beans, pumpkin and potatoes cooked together and crushed, dressed with onion fried in oil.
Quadrati di pasta all'uovo arrotolati su: Squares of egg pasta rolled around a filling of veal, chicken, chicken livers and dried mushrooms with Marsala, baked with béchamel and tomato.
Quadretti di sfoglia all'uovo cotti nel: Squares of egg pasta cooked in hen broth spiced with cloves, nutmeg and cinnamon, with parmesan and scamorza.
Quadrotti di pasta morbida allo strutto: Squares of soft lard dough filled with tomato, cooked ham, provola and frankfurters, sprinkled with sesame and baked.
Quadrotti di polenta abbrustolita copert: Squares of toasted polenta topped with garlic spinach and a cream of gorgonzola and cream, with chopped almonds.
Quadrotti di polenta farciti con acciugh: Squares of polenta sandwiched with anchovy sauce, then fried or baked: the little Lombard starter that calls for a toast.
Quadrotti di polenta soda dorati nel bur: Squares of firm polenta browned in butter and topped with soft gorgonzola that melts, to be served hot.
Quaglie marinate in olio e aceto e cotte: Quails marinated in oil and vinegar and cooked in a bottle of white wine with vegetables, cloves, nutmeg and herbs.
Radicchio, indivia e cipolle rosse grigl: Radicchio, endive and red onions grilled and dressed with an emulsion of oil, lemon, honey and mint.
Ragù di manzo e maiale tagliati a coltel: Ragù of knife-chopped beef and pork, browned in lard and slowly cooked in tomato with parsley and basil.
Ragù di polpa di castrato a pezzetti cot: Ragù of mutton in small pieces cooked with lard, garlic, rosemary and chilli in wine and tomato.
Ragù di polpa di cinghiale marinata nel: Ragù of wild boar marinated in red wine with herbs, cooked slowly in passata with lard, for homemade pasta.
Ragù di tre carni tritate a coltello con: Ragù of three knife-chopped meats with pancetta, cooked slowly with red wine, tomato sauce and a clove: the sauce for Sunday pasta.
Rana pescatrice a tranci cotta nel pomod: Monkfish steaks cooked in fresh tomato with white wine, garlic, rosemary, marjoram and a piece of chilli.
Rane infarinate e rosolate nel burro, co: Floured frogs browned in butter, cooked in white wine with tomato, chard and garlic, as in the Vercelli rice fields.
Ravioli di farina di farro e pane di seg: Ravioli of spelt flour and rye bread filled with smoked meat, served with mascarpone cream and black truffle.
Ravioli di farina di segale e di grano r: Ravioli of rye and wheat flour filled with sautéed porcini, dressed with a fontina fonduta with truffle.
Ravioli di pasta all'uovo ripieni di ort: Egg-pasta ravioli filled with nettles, spinach and ricotta with lemon and marjoram, dressed with ragù.
Ravioli di pasta allo strutto ripieni di: Ravioli of lard pastry filled with wild boar cooked with tomato and spices, fried in a pan.
Ravioli di pasta frolla morbida agli agr: Ravioli of soft citrus pastry filled with sheep's ricotta, chocolate chips, candied citron and pine nuts, fried and dusted with icing sugar.
Ravioli dolci di Natale ripieni di casta: Sweet Christmas ravioli filled with chestnuts, chocolate, almonds and candied fruit, fried and dipped in honey or sugar.
Ravioli dolci di pasta al vino e strutto: Sweet ravioli of dough with wine and lard filled with sweetened sheep's ricotta, fried and drizzled with honey.
Razza petrosa infarinata e fritta, poi l: Thornback ray floured and fried, then left for days in saffron-coloured vinegar: the scapece of Termoli.
Reginette condite con il ragù napoletano: Reginette dressed with Neapolitan ragù of beef short ribs, pork ribs and sausage and served with a spoonful of buffalo ricotta and basil.
Ricottine fresche di latte vaccino con n: Fresh cow's milk ricotta moulds with chopped walnuts and walnut oil, turned out on a bed of dressed rocket.
Rigatoni al forno con pancetta rosolata,: Baked rigatoni with browned pancetta, diced fontina and a little cream, browned until the cheese melts.
Rigatoni con i cavoletti di Bruxelles le: Rigatoni with boiled and sautéed Brussels sprouts, in a soft béchamel baked with grana.
Rigatoni di mais con il radicchio di Tre: Corn rigatoni with stewed Treviso radicchio and cream, finished with grana and chopped walnuts.
Rigatoni mantecati con una crema di font: Rigatoni creamed with a sauce of fontina and cream and beef mocetta in strips.

Riso Vialone Nano lessato al dente e con: Vialone Nano rice boiled al dente and simply dressed with butter and grana, as it was given to children and convalescents.

Riso e castagne secche cotti nel brodo d: Rice and dried chestnuts cooked in meat broth, finished with fontina and chives.

Riso lessato al dente e condito con le a: Rice boiled al dente and dressed with anchovies melted in hot oil and chopped parsley.
Riso lessato e condito con il burro, cop: Boiled rice dressed with butter, covered with a hot Aosta Valley fonduta of fontina, milk and yolks.
Riso, verze e luganega è un risotto d'in: Rice, cabbage and luganega is a winter risotto from all over the Veneto; the soy sauce is a modern addition standing in for the stock cube of old.

Risotto con i peperoni rossi e gialli di: Risotto with red and yellow Voghera peppers in cubes, sautéed with onion and deglazed with white wine.
Risotto con il sedano e la cipolla stufa: Risotto with stewed celery and onion and a little tomato sauce, finished with butter and grana.
Risotto con le castagne lessate e sbrici: Risotto with boiled crumbled chestnuts, deglazed with cognac and scented with marjoram, finished with butter.
Risotto con le mele a dadini cotte nel b: Risotto with diced apples cooked in butter and deglazed with white wine, finished with grana and lemon zest.
Risotto cotto nel brodo dei carapaci deg: Risotto cooked in langoustine shell stock with a little tomato, finished with butter and the tails and parsley.
Risotto cotto nel brodo dello stoccafiss: Risotto cooked in stockfish broth with vegetables, finished with butter and stockfish flesh and parsley.
Risotto cotto nel brodo di coda di manzo: Risotto cooked in oxtail stock, deglazed with Valpolicella Ripasso and finished with parmesan and a pinch of cinnamon.

Risotto mantecato al vino rosso dell'Olt: Risotto cooked with red wine from the Oltrepò with calf's kidney in thin slices, browned separately in butter.

Risotto mantecato con il vino rosso Tero: Risotto finished with Teroldego Rotaliano red wine, which dyes it purple, with grana and butter.

Rombi di una polentina di farina e semol: Diamonds of a stiff flour and semolina porridge cooked with bay, cooled, fried and covered with icing sugar.
Rose di prosciutto crudo di Parma arroto: Roses of Parma ham rolled up on a bed of rocket dressed with oil and balsamic vinegar, with parmesan shavings.
Roseto degli Abruzzi, sulla costa terama: Roseto degli Abruzzi, on the Teramo coast, was a fishing village: Adriatic red mullet and inland prosciutto meet in this dish, which Ricette Regionali calls alla rosetana.
Rosolarla in una casseruola con il burro: Brown it in a casserole with the butter for 10 minutes, until coloured; add the heart, liver and lung in small pieces, if available.
Rostide vuol dire rosolate, arrostite in: Rostide means browned, roasted in the pan: it is the Trentino way of giving flavour to winter cabbage; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Rotolini di una pasta veloce di farina,: Little rolls of a quick pastry of flour, butter and goat's cheese, rolled around anchovies and baked.
Rotolo di frittata ai piselli cotto in f: Pea omelette roll baked in the oven, filled with fresh cheese, prosciutto, sun-dried tomatoes and olives.
Rotolo di pasta sfoglia fatta in casa ri: Roll of homemade puff pastry filled with asparagus, béchamel and cheese, brushed with egg yolk and baked.
Rotolo senza cottura di castagne lessate: No-bake roll of boiled and sieved chestnuts with butter, sugar, cocoa and rum, filled with mascarpone.
Ru muacche è una delle polente più ricch: Ru muacche is one of the richest polentas of Alto Molise, the dish of autumn feasts when porcini are gathered; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Salame di cioccolato, cacao, burro, bisc: Chocolate salami of cocoa, butter, crumbled biscuits and almonds, scented with rum and sliced.
Salsa dolce e piccante di miele, senape: Sweet and spicy sauce of honey, mustard and chopped walnuts, loosened with a little broth, to serve with boiled meats.
Salsa ligure di aglio pestato con la mol: Ligurian sauce of pounded garlic with bread crumb soaked in vinegar, thinned with white wine, for boiled and fried fish.
Salsa rossa agrodolce di pomodori, peper: Sweet-and-sour red sauce of tomatoes, pepper and vegetables cooked slowly and puréed, with vinegar, sugar and chilli, for boiled meats.

Salsicce rosolate con le cipolle e sfuma: Sausages browned with onions and deglazed with red wine vinegar into a sweet-and-sour sauce, served with polenta.

Sardine crude marinate nel limone e serv: Raw sardines marinated in lemon and served with a sauce of anchovies, pine nuts and parsley.

Scaldare il forno a 170 °C; imburrare e: Heat the oven to 170 °C; butter and flour a 22 cm tin.
Scaldare il forno a 180 °C e foderare du: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line two trays with baking paper.

Scampi saltati in padella con aglio, cip: Langoustines sautéed in a pan with garlic, onion, green pepper and an anchovy, deglazed with cognac and finished with herbs.
Scarola e fagioli è la minestra di tutti: Escarole and beans is the everyday soup of southern Lazio, towards Campania.
Scattarisciati, in dialetto, vuol dire s: Scattarisciati, in dialect, means burst: pennula tomatoes, hung in bunches for the winter, are cooked this way over high heat.
Scolare il baccalà, togliere pelle e spi: Drain the salt cod, remove skin and bones and cut it into pieces; slice the spring onions and cut the tomatoes into large chunks.
Scottare le mandorle dolci e le mandorle: Blanch the sweet and the bitter almonds in boiling water for 2 minutes, peel them and dry them in the oven at 100 °C for 10 minutes.
Scuma vuol dire schiuma, per la leggerez: Scuma means foam, for the lightness of the fried pasta nests; it is a dish of the monsù, the French-trained cooks of Palermo's noble houses. Ricette Regionali gives it with the aggrassatu juices.
Sedano rapa di Verona a fiammiferi con l: Verona celeriac in matchsticks with green apple, dressed with apple vinegar and mayonnaise.
Semifreddo di panna e crema di tuorli co: Semifreddo of cream and egg-yolk custard with crushed almond brittle folded in, served with caramelised almonds and melted chocolate.
Semifreddo di panna, uova e cioccolato b: Semifreddo of cream, eggs and white chocolate with chopped walnuts, served with a vanilla custard sauce.
Semifreddo di uova, panna e nocino, il l: Semifreddo of eggs, cream and nocino, the Emilian walnut liqueur, with chopped walnuts and dark chocolate.
Semola di grano duro e ricotta di pecora: Durum wheat semolina and sheep's ricotta are the base of Sardinian bread-making; GialloZafferano gives these rolls among the island's regional recipes.
Semolino cotto nel latte con lo zucchero: Semolina cooked in milk with sugar and lemon, set, cut into diamonds, breaded and fried, one of the sweets of the fritto misto.
Senza salsiccia, solo con aglio, olio e: Without sausage or lard, just with garlic, oil and chilli, for a vegan dish.

Sogliole intere coperte di pangrattato,: Whole soles covered with breadcrumbs, pecorino, garlic and parsley and baked au gratin with oil.

Spaghetti conditi con un sugo semplice d: Spaghetti dressed with a simple sauce of fresh tomatoes cooked in oil with garlic.
Spaghetti grossi con una salsa cruda di: Thick spaghetti with a raw sauce of walnuts pounded with milk, garlic, parsley and nutmeg.

Una pasta al forno d'inverno della cucin: A winter baked pasta from home cooking, made everywhere in the north when the garden has Brussels sprouts, sweet after the first frosts.
Una torta salata di casa, fatta in tutta: A home savoury tart, made all over Italy with summer vegetables; poplar mushrooms grow on poplar trunks along the rivers of the plain.
Una variante moderna dei crostoli di Car: A modern variant of Carnival crostoli, the Venetian galani: the nuts in the dough and the custard for dipping turn them into a dessert.
Unire due terzi delle mele e versare in: Add two thirds of the apples and pour into a buttered 24 cm tin.
Unire i pomodori e un bicchiere d'acqua: Add the tomatoes and a glass of water and cook for about 10 minutes, until the tomatoes break down.
Uno stuzzichino da aperitivo della Rivie: An aperitif snack from the Riviera: Ligurian Sea anchovies, salted at home, meet a crumbly pastry that takes minutes to make.
Uova all'occhio di bue cotte nel burro,: Fried eggs cooked in butter, covered with parmesan and thin shavings of white truffle.
Uova sbattute strapazzate nel sugo di po: Beaten eggs scrambled in tomato sauce and poured over slices of toasted stale bread: the “cacio e uova” of lean days, without the cheese.
Uova sode farcite con i tuorli schiaccia: Hard-boiled eggs filled with the yolks mashed with tuna, oil and parsley, and a grating of grey mullet bottarga on top.
Uova sode farcite con il loro tuorlo e u: Hard-boiled eggs stuffed with their yolk and a thick parmesan béchamel, breaded and fried.
Uova sode ripiene di tuorli, pane all'ac: Hard-boiled eggs filled with yolks, vinegar-soaked bread, mint, sugar, cinnamon and candied citron, covered with the same cream thinned with vinegar: a sweet-and-sour starter.
Vellutata di zucca e porro cotta nel lat: Velvety soup of pumpkin and leek cooked in milk, bound with cream and finished with grated fontina that melts in the bowl.
Ventresche di stoccafisso arrotolate con: Stockfish belly pieces rolled around a filling of stockfish, eggs, pecorino, breadcrumbs and parsley, cooked in tomato sauce.
Verdure crude di stagione, cipollotti e: Raw seasonal vegetables, spring onions and young garlic dipped in olive oil with salt, the spring starter of the Langhe.
Verdure d'estate a pezzi, melanzana, zuc: Summer vegetables in pieces, aubergine, courgette, pepper, carrots and celery, stewed sweet and sour with capers and calamint.
Verdure dell'estate stufate insieme: pat: Summer vegetables stewed together: potatoes, peppers, eggplants, tomatoes and onion, scented with mint and basil.
Verdure dell'orto d'autunno stufate a lu: Autumn garden vegetables cooked slowly with pancetta and thyme until they melt together, finished with pieces of toma cheese.
Verdure di stagione e patate lessate, ri: Seasonal vegetables and potatoes, boiled and sautéed with garlic and chilli and mixed with corn pizza baked under the “coppo” and crumbled in: the peasant soup of the Trabocchi Coast.
Verdure e patate lessate, ripassate con: Boiled greens and potatoes, finished with garlic and chilli and mixed with crumbled maize pizza: the peasant soup of the Trabocchi coast.
Vermicelli con le cozze e le vongole ver: Vermicelli with mussels and clams opened in a pan and cherry tomatoes, with garlic and pepper.
Vermicelli con pane raffermo tostato in: Vermicelli with stale breadcrumbs toasted in the pan with oil and salted anchovies until crisp: Cavalcanti's dish for the Neapolitan Christmas Eve.
Vermicelli conditi con pane raffermo gra: Vermicelli dressed with grated stale bread toasted in a pan with oil and salted anchovies until golden and crisp: the Neapolitan Christmas Eve dish in Cavalcanti's “cucina casareccia” (home cooking).
Vermicelli cotti con i ceci e il loro br: Vermicelli cooked with chickpeas and their broth, with onion, bay leaf and good oil: one of the dishes of the St Joseph's Tables in Giurdignano.
Versare in una tortiera imburrata di 24: Pour into a buttered 24-centimetre cake tin.
Versare in una tortiera imburrata e cuoc: Pour into a buttered cake tin and bake in the oven at 170 °C for 40 minutes.
Pour into a buttered cake tin and bake in the oven at 170 °C for 45 minutes.

Pour into a buttered and floured 22 cm tin.
Versare in uno stampo imburrato di 22 cm: Pour into a buttered 22 cm tin and bake in a hot oven at 170 °C for 40 minutes.
Versare l'impasto e cuocere in forno a 1: Pour in the mixture and bake in the oven at 180 °C for 35 minutes.
Versarla nella padella, mantecare con il: Tip it into the pan, stir in the Parmigiano Reggiano with a little cooking water if needed, grind over the black pepper and serve topped with the fennel fronds.
Verza cappuccia cotta a lungo nella pass: Savoy cabbage cooked slowly in passata with pork ribs, rinds, trotters and guanciale.
Verza e baccalà sono un piatto d'inverno: Savoy cabbage and salt cod are a winter dish of Molise homes, when the garden gives cabbages and the pantry dried fish; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Verza lessata e ripassata nel lardo con: Savoy cabbage boiled and sautéed in lard with garlic, bound with egg and grana: a homely side dish.
Verza stufata a lungo nello strutto con: Savoy cabbage slowly stewed in lard with onion and white wine, until soft and dark.
Verza stufata nel burro con la pancetta: Savoy cabbage stewed in butter with smoked pancetta and thickened with a spoonful of toasted flour.
Verza tagliata fine e stufata a lungo ne: Finely cut savoy cabbage stewed for a long time in a covered pan with sausage, onion, garlic and rosemary.
Verza tagliata fine stufata con il lardo: Finely cut savoy cabbage stewed with lard melted until crisp and deglazed with vinegar.
Verza, rape, bietole e barbabietola sbol: Savoy cabbage, turnips, chard and beetroot, blanched and layered with salt and spices, then left to ferment for two weeks: the winter preserve of the high Aosta Valley.
Verzini, salsicce milanesi da cuocere, r: Verzini, Milanese cooking sausages, browned and cooked in red beer with potatoes and Jerusalem artichokes with rosemary.
Vongole veraci aperte in tegame con l'ol: Carpet-shell clams opened in a pan with oil, garlic and white wine and served in their juices with parsley.
Würstel e crauti sono il piatto delle fe: Frankfurters and sauerkraut are the dish of village festivals and Christmas markets in South Tyrol, brought by Austro-German cooking; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
Zafferano e cozze sono due prodotti sard: Saffron and mussels are two Sardinian products, the saffron of San Gavino and the mussels of Olbia; with gnocchi and cream it is a modern first course, which Ricette Regionali gives this way.
Zengarielle, spaghetti grossi, conditi c: Zengarielle, thick spaghetti, dressed with salted anchovies melted in oil with onion and toasted breadcrumb.
Zeppole di pasta cotta all'acqua con gli: Zeppole of water-cooked dough with citrus, fried and coated in warm honey with coloured sprinkles.
Ziti o penne conditi con un sugo di pomo: Ziti or penne dressed with a tomato sauce cooked with lard and onion, finished with plenty of pecorino.
Zucchine a rondelle cotte nel burro finc: Courgette rounds cooked in butter until golden and then covered with grated pecorino that melts over the heat.
Zucchine a rondelle saltate nel burro e: Courgette rounds sautéed in butter and baked with beaten eggs and mozzarella, into a soft bake.
Zucchine e pomodori cotti con la cipolla: Courgettes and tomatoes cooked with onion in a light soup scented with parsley.
Zucchine fritte e poi lasciate in una ma: Fried courgettes left in a warm marinade of oil, vinegar, garlic, sage and mint, to be eaten cold the next day.
Zucchine infarinate e fritte, a strati c: Courgettes floured and fried, layered with parmesan and provola, moistened with butter and red stock and gratinated: Cavalcanti's parmigiana (1839).
Zucchine stufate con i pomodori e la cip: Courgettes stewed with tomatoes and onion, bound at the end with beaten eggs and cheese.
Zucchine svuotate e ripiene della loro p: Courgettes hollowed out and filled with their own flesh with onion, parmesan, breadcrumbs, egg and parsley, baked in tomato.
Zuppa densa di ceci cotti con porro, pat: Thick soup of chickpeas cooked with leek, potato and camona tomatoes, combined with wedge clams opened with garlic and chilli, over toasted bread.
Zuppa densa di cipolle di Cannara stufat: A thick soup of Cannara onions stewed with lard and tomato, bound with eggs and served in a cup with toasted bread.
Zuppa densa di fagioli secchi passati, c: Thick soup of puréed dried beans, with potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, garlic and rosemary and a little tomato paste.
Zuppa di borlotti lessati e scarola cott: Soup of boiled borlotti beans and escarole cooked with a base of pancetta and onion and tomatoes.
Zuppa di cardi lessati e poi cotti nel b: Soup of cardoons boiled and then cooked in meat broth, bound at the end with beaten eggs and grana: the dish of winter feast days.
Zuppa di cipolle rosse di Tropea stufate: Soup of Tropea red onions stewed in oil, thickened with a spoonful of flour and cooked in stock, served on croutons.
Zuppa di cozze, arselle, vongole, cannol: Soup of mussels, wedge clams, clams, razor clams, warty venus and crabs opened with garlic, herbs and Vernaccia, served over bread.
Zuppa di fagioli toscanelli lessati con: Soup of toscanelli beans boiled with garlic and sage, poured over toasted country bread and dressed with new oil.
Zuppa di farina tostata nell'olio e nel: Soup of flour toasted in oil and butter to a hazelnut colour, thinned with water and finished with smoked pancetta and parmesan.
Zuppa di farro decorticato e castagne co: Soup of pearled spelt and chestnuts with chanterelles and leeks, cooked in stock with bay leaf and thyme.
Zuppa di gamberi freschi cotti in un bro: Soup of fresh prawns cooked in a broth made with their heads and vegetables, with parsley and pepper.
Zuppa di granciporri con fave, fagioli,: Soup of edible crabs with broad beans, beans, green beans, potatoes, sweetcorn and peas, cooked in the crab broth with a dash of vinegar.
Zuppa di manzo a cubetti e patate cotta: Soup of cubed beef and potatoes cooked in broth with onion, paprika, caraway, marjoram and thyme, the Tyrolean Gulaschsuppe.
Zuppa di montagna di lenticchie, patate: A mountain soup of lentils, potatoes and chicory, with garlic and good oil: one of the dishes of Capracotta, in the upper Molise.
Zuppa di pane raffermo fritto nel burro,: Soup of stale bread fried in butter, layered with parmesan and eggs, soaked in stock and baked.
Zuppa di pane toscano con totanetti, gam: Tuscan bread soup with baby squid, prawns and wedge clams cooked with garlic, tomato and white wine, in fish stock.
Zuppa di pesce dell'Adriatico con merluz: Adriatic fish soup with cod, gurnard, curled octopus, shellfish, clams and mussels, cooked in a tomato fish stock.
Zuppa di piselli e cime di rapa con l'ag: Soup of peas and turnip tops with garlic and chilli, served on toasted stale bread.
Zuppa di primavera di fave, piselli, car: Spring soup of broad beans, peas, artichokes, escarole and spring onion cooked in stock, with a poached egg and toasted bread.
Zuppa di rape, porri e orzo perlato con: Soup of turnips, leeks and pearl barley with saffron and white wine, thickened with wholemeal flour.
Zuppa di steli teneri di ortica cotti co: Soup of tender nettle stems cooked with pancetta, onion and fresh tomatoes.
Zuppa di verza, fagioli, patate e pomodo: Soup of savoy cabbage, beans, potatoes and tomato cooked in stock with thyme, poured over slices of bread.
Zuppa di zucca bianca, patate e fagioli: Soup of white pumpkin, potatoes and beans cooked in buttermilk with rosemary, bay leaf and sage.
Zuppa dolce di latte, uova, vino rosso,: A sweet soup of milk, eggs, red wine, walnuts and grissini, scented with cinnamon: in Courmayeur it was the “luxury” kept for women who had just given birth.

«Alla fiorentina», nella cucina francese: «Florentine», in French and international cooking, means with spinach: a tribute to Catherine de' Medici, who is said to have brought it to Paris.
«Alla frantoiana» vuol dire alla maniera: «Alla frantoiana» means in the style of the olive mill: an autumn dressing with olives and new oil, when the Umbrian mills are working.
«Alla maruzzella» vuol dire come le luma: «Alla maruzzella» means like snails, with garlic, oil and parsley: it was how Neapolitan street vendors cooked maruzze and later fish too.
«Alla poderana» vuol dire alla maniera d: «Alla poderana» means in the style of the podere, the Tuscan farm: a spring sauce with what the garden and the pantry give.
«Bacilli» in ligure sono le fave; «accom: «Bacilli» in Ligurian are broad beans; «accomodè» means stewed, like stockfish accomodato. They are made in spring, when broad beans are fresh.
«Broeto» in veneziano vuol dire brodetto: «Broeto» in Venetian means fish soup: in the homes of lagoon fishermen it was made with whatever was left in the net, here with prawns alone.
«Fronne» sono le fronde, le foglie: in C: «Fronne» are fronds, leaves: in Ciociaria potatoes with cabbage leaves are the winter side dish of country homes.

«In porchetta» vuol dire cucinato come i: «In porchetta» means cooked like the fairground pig, with wild fennel: in Umbria goose, duck and carp are also cooked this way.
«Pillottare» in toscano vuol dire lardel: «Pillottare» in Tuscan means to lard, and once also to baste the roast with melted lard dripping from the «pillotto»; it is the Easter lamb.
«Ruzze» vuol dire ruvide: le ciambelle a: «Ruzze» means rough: the wine rings of Ciociaria are dunked in wine at the end of the meal and keep for weeks.
«Sofegae» vuol dire soffocate: la verza: «Sofegae» means smothered: the cabbage cooks covered, without water, until it turns sweet and soft. It is the winter side dish of the whole Venetian countryside.
«Vongole fujute», scappate, è lo scherzo: «Vongole fujute», escaped clams, is the joke of poor Neapolitan cooking: the sauce is that of spaghetti with clams, but the clams are not there.

È il modo più antico di cucinare la cacc: It is the oldest way of cooking big game in inland homes: a long marinade in wine and slow cooking. Ricette Regionali gives it among the Sardinian main courses.
È il modo più semplice di portare in tav: It is the simplest way to bring fonduta to the table, the valley's emblematic dish; Ricette Regionali pours it over boiled rice, as is done at home.
È il piatto d'inverno del giorno del mai: It is the winter dish of pig-slaughter day in the Molise countryside, with the parts that were not cured; Ricette Regionali calls it cappuccia.

È il primo della Vigilia di Natale e dei: It is the first course of Christmas Eve and Fridays in many Molise homes, where toasted breadcrumb replaces cheese; Ricette Regionali gives it with zengarielle.
È il primo della Vigilia di Natale in mo: It is the Christmas Eve first course in many Molise villages, when no meat is eaten: salt cod and walnuts are the ingredients of the feast. Ricette Regionali gives it with crioli.

È il sugo della domenica delle famiglie: It is the Sunday sauce of Sardinian families, with meat cut with the point of a knife instead of minced; Ricette Regionali gives it among the first courses.
È l'antipasto delle trattorie romane, cu: It is the starter of Roman trattorias, a cousin of «provatura»: mozzarella melted on bread with anchovy butter.

È l'insalata delle estati abruzzesi, tra: It is the salad of Abruzzo summers, between vegetable garden and pantry: seasonal vegetables are completed with tinned tuna and with chilli, which in Abruzzo is called diavolillo. Ricette Regionali gives it among the region's side dishes.
È la cena veloce d'estate delle case mol: It is the quick summer supper of Molise homes, with garden courgettes and eggs from the henhouse; Ricette Regionali gives it among the main courses.

È la ciambotta d'estate delle campagne m: It is the summer ciambotta of the Molise countryside, with garden vegetables cooked together in a single pan; Ricette Regionali gives it among the side dishes.
È la fregola di terra dell'interno, con: It is the inland, land-based fregola, with home pork products: fresh sausage and cracklings, the gerda; Ricette Regionali gives it among the Sardinian first courses.
È la merenda estiva dei contadini molisa: It is the summer snack of Molise farmers, who carried dry taralli to the fields and softened them with tomato juice; Ricette Regionali calls it composta.
È la minestra d'estate dell'orto molisan: It is the summer soup of the Molise vegetable garden, when courgettes are plentiful; Ricette Regionali gives it among the first courses.

È la polenta liquida della Valtellina, s: It is the liquid polenta of the Valtellina, the poor sister of polenta taragna, eaten with a spoon; casera is the valley's DOP cheese.
È la sorella catanese della pasta con le: It is the Catania sister of Palermo's pasta con le sarde: anchovies, mascolini, instead of sardines, with the same wild fennel, raisins and pine nuts. Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
È la variante con il manzo della costole: It is the beef version of the cotoletta alla valdostana, the dish of the valley's trattorias with fontina melting on breaded meat; Ricette Regionali gives it this way.
È la versione con la carne degli gnocchi: It is the meat version of Sorrento-style gnocchi, as made in the homes of Capri and the peninsula: halfway between gnocchi and baked pasta.
È la versione di casa della cotoletta al: It is the home version of the Bolognese cutlet, with chicken and cooked ham; it is made all over Italy under the same name.

È la versione di casa, più leggera, dell: It is the lighter home version of the cotoletta alla valdostana: chicken instead of veal and no breading. Ricette Regionali gives it among the region's main courses.
È la vignarola fatta zuppa: le fave, i p: It is vignarola turned into soup: broad beans, peas and Romanesco artichokes arrive together on Rome's market stalls in April.
È lo scapece della costa pugliese, il mo: It is the scapece of the Apulian coast, the old way of keeping oily fish for a few days; it is served as a starter.
È lo stesso condimento delle fettuccine: It is the same sauce as fettuccine all'abruzzese, with garlic added: Ricette Regionali gives the two recipes side by side, as happens in homes, where you use the pasta you have.
È un antipasto da festa della cucina bor: It is a party starter of Emilian middle-class cooking, in the family of cold mousses; the butter keeps it firm like a pâté.
È un antipasto da festa moderno, che si: It is a modern party starter found all over Italy; Ricette Regionali gives it among the Sardinian recipes with homemade puff pastry. With ready-made pastry you can skip the folds.
È un antipasto da festa moderno, della f: It is a modern party starter, in the family of Russian salad; Ricette Regionali gives it among the Trentino recipes for the region's porcini and apples.
È un antipasto delle cittadine di mare t: It is a starter of the seaside towns between Giulianova, Pescara and Vasto, where shellfish is eaten just caught; on the Abruzzo page of Ricette Regionali it is simply called «insalata di crudo», because the dressing is not cooked.
È un antipasto freddo dei pranzi borghes: It is a cold starter of nineteenth-century Milanese bourgeois lunches, when aspic and truffle were the sign of a feast.
È un antipasto moderno costruito sulla f: It is a modern starter built on the Aosta Valley fontina fonduta; Ricette Regionali gives it with ready-made flatbreads, here without naming the brand.
È un antipasto moderno di GialloZafferan: It is a modern GialloZafferano starter, made ahead for parties; it is made all over Italy.
È un antipasto moderno e veloce che si t: It is a modern, quick starter found all over Italy; bresaola comes from Valtellina. Ricette Regionali lists it among Piedmontese dishes.
È un arrosto delle feste d'inverno, quan: It is a roast for winter feasts, when pomegranates ripen; Ricette Regionali lists it among Aosta Valley dishes, but it is a dish of all Italy.
È un condimento di casa, da dispensa con: It is a home sauce, from the farmhouse pantry: pancetta, onions and the two cheeses; Ricette Regionali gives it with fettuccine and, almost the same, with spaghetti.
È un condimento di casa, veloce, con la: It is a quick home sauce, with the pancetta and pecorino that are never missing from a Molise pantry; Ricette Regionali calls it alla molisana.
È un contorno della cucina contadina lom: It is a side dish of Lombard peasant cooking, bringing together cabbage, lard and cheese like cassoeula; Ricette Regionali gives it with its dialect name.
